An instruction cites a CVT entry rather than a raw number, so one change to the table reaches every glyph that cites it. You work with it through the TrueType Hinting panel. It ships in the font, alongside the instructions themselves and the prep and fpgm programs that set the machine up. design space variation range дизайн-пространство proposed Contrast Foundry's glossary of variable fonts uses дизайн-пространство; type.today writes дизайн-спейс. Rejected: пространство вариаций (fallback), not attested. A design space describes the positions defined by a font project's variation axes. Masters provide source data at specified locations; instances represent results at selected locations. User coordinates and internal design coordinates may be connected by a mapping, or may have the same values. State which coordinate system a number belongs to when the distinction affects a procedure. device correction per-size pixel correction поправка для размера proposed No attestation; fallback translated. FontForge calls the OpenType structure таблица устройства. A device correction adjusts a kerning or positioning value by whole pixels at one pixel size, to fix rounding at that size only. Stored in GPOS device tables; rarely needed on modern rasterizers. dimensions размеры proposed Glyphs 3 (ru): Dimensions = Размеры. Keep it apart from метрики (glyph spacing) and измерения (canvas measurements). The font or family vertical values, such as ascender, descender, capital height, x-height and line gap. Distinguish these values from glyph spacing and canvas measurements. element элемент proposed FontLab's own object; the cognate is the only candidate. Keep it distinct from компонент and ссылка. An element is FontLab's container for a piece of drawing inside a glyph: one or more contours, an image, or a reference to another element. A glyph holds elements, and an element holds contours, which is the layer of structure that makes a serif or a stem reusable across a family. You work with elements in the Elements panel and with the Element tool. The word is FontLab's own; other editors call the nearest thing a path group or a component. element reference shared drawing link ссылка на элемент proposed Derived from ссылка and элемент; write ссылки where the English says only references. An element reference is a placed copy of an element that still points at the original. Edit the original and every reference updates. You use references to share a serif, a stem, or a whole letter across a family, and you decompose a reference only when a glyph genuinely needs to diverge. A component is the familiar case of an element reference: one glyph placed inside another. Keep references intact through the design phase, since decomposing early throws away the link that makes a late change cheap. family dimensions размеры семейства proposed Derived from размеры; семейство is the Glyphs and Apple word for a font family in naming contexts. Гарнитура stays the word for typeface in prose. The vertical values used to establish line layout for a font family. Platform-specific ascender, descender and line-gap fields belong to this group. Flex флекс proposed Glyphs 3 (ru): Flex = Флекс; fixed name of the Type 1 hint. FontForge writes flex-инструкция. Flex is a PostScript hint that flattens a shallow curve, such as a cup serif, to a straight line at small sizes. FontLab marks glyphs that carry it. Keep the name. font dimensions размеры шрифта proposed Derived from размеры; no attestation. The design dimensions of a font master, including ascender, descender, capital height and x-height. These values describe the vertical proportions of the design. font target export target целевой шрифт proposed No attestation; fallback translated. Where the English says only target, write цель. A font target is what TransType produces from a source: the output font, with its format, its names, and the filters applied on the way. Sources go in on one side and targets come out on the other, and one source can produce several targets. You set the target options before you convert, and you name the target in a procedure step so a reader knows which side of the conversion a setting belongs to. font unit единица шрифта proposed Compositional; ParaType calls it цифровая (машинная) единица and Glyphs юнит (jargon). A font unit is the coordinate step of a font's design grid. UPM says how many of them make one em, so a 700 unit stem in a 1000 UPM font is 70 percent of the em. Metrics, kerning values and node coordinates are all stated in font units. fractional coordinates non-integer coordinates дробные координаты proposed No attestation; plain mathematical Russian. Fractional coordinates are node positions with decimal places, kept for curve fidelity while you draw. Font formats store integers, so FontLab rounds on export or when you turn on Round coordinates for the font. friendly glyph name readable glyph name удобное имя глифа proposed Glyphs 3 (ru): Make Nice Glyph Names = Создать удобные имена. Rejected: читаемое имя (fallback). A friendly glyph name is the readable name FontLab shows for editing, such as Aacute, as opposed to the production name written into the exported font, such as uni00C1. FontLab can keep both and convert on export. ghost hint edge-only fitting instruction приводящий хинт proposed Glyphs 3 (ru): Make Ghost Hint = Сделать приводящий хинт. Rejected: призрачный хинт (unattested calque); односторонний хинт would be the descriptive option. A ghost hint is a PostScript hint with a special width that marks one edge, such as the top of a round letter, when there is no stem to hint. It aligns that edge to an alignment zone. hint screen fitting instruction хинт proposed ParaType terminology and Glyphs 3 (ru). Rejected: инструкция (FontForge), which ParaType reserves for TrueType instructions. A hint is a stored instruction that tells a rasterizer how to align a stem or a zone to the pixel grid at small sizes. PostScript hints describe stems and zones; TrueType hints are instructions. FontLab draws hints in the Glyph window and generates them with autohinting. The word stays English in every language. hint zone hinting height band зона хинтинга proposed Derived from хинтинг and зона; Glyphs says зона. No attestation of the compound. A hint zone is a horizontal band, such as the baseline or the x-height, inside which a rasterizer snaps overshoots to the same pixel row. FontLab stores zones in Font Info and shows them in the Glyph window. An alignment zone is the PostScript name for the same thing; hint zone is the general term. hinting screen fitting хинтинг proposed Glyphs 3 (ru) and current professional usage; matches ParaType's own Автохинтинг and the кернинг, трекинг pattern. Rejected: хинтование (ParaType, editor-aligned pair), хинтовка (ParaType site). Verb: хинтовать. Hinting is the extra information a font carries so that its outlines land predictably on a pixel grid at small sizes. PostScript hinting declares stems and alignment zones and leaves the rasterizer to interpret them. TrueType hinting gives instructions that move points explicitly, with the control values in the CVT table. You work on PostScript hints in the glyph and in Font Info, and on TrueType hints with the TrueType Hinting tool and panel. Autohinting produces a starting point you then correct. instance generated design экземпляр proposed FontForge (ru) and Adobe; neutral and declinable. Rejected: образец (Glyphs; also means sample), инстанс (jargon), промежуточное начертание (Contrast Foundry; not every instance is intermediate). An instance is a particular result at a location in a font's variation space. A named instance, such as Semibold, gives a selected location a name that applications can present. Other locations need not have names. In FontLab, configured instances can be exported as static fonts or included as named instances in a variable font. interpolation интерполяция proposed ParaType terminology, Glyphs 3 (ru), FontForge (ru). Interpolation calculates values between source values. In font design, it can calculate outlines, metrics and other data from masters at specified design-space locations. Outline interpolation requires corresponding contour and point structures. Structural compatibility makes the calculation possible, but does not guarantee a good drawing: inspect intermediate results as well as the masters. Extrapolation calculates beyond the source range. kern exception pair spacing exception исключение кернинга proposed Derived from кернинг; no attestation. A kern exception is a pair value that overrides what the classes would otherwise apply. One member of a class rarely behaves like the rest, and the exception says so without breaking the class apart. You create one in the Kerning panel by kerning the single pair while its classes stay in place. Keep exceptions few: a class with many exceptions is the wrong class, and the cheaper fix is to split it rather than to list every disagreement. kerning pair spacing correction кернинг proposed ParaType terminology, Glyphs 3 (ru), FontForge (ru), Adobe. Verb: кернить; adjective: кернинговый. Kerning adjusts the spacing of particular glyph combinations beyond their normal advances. A pair such as AV may need a different gap from the one produced by its unadjusted metrics. OpenType fonts commonly store horizontal kerning in GPOS lookups associated with the kern feature; some formats and workflows use a separate kern table. Name the mechanism when it matters to export or compatibility. kerning class pair spacing group класс кернинга proposed Corpus best pick; Glyphs 3 (ru) has both кернинг-класс and группа кернинга. A kerning class groups glyphs that need the same kerning. You put every glyph that behaves alike on one side into one class, then kern the class once instead of kerning each pair inside it. FontLab applies the class value to every member pair and keeps single pairs as exceptions where a member needs its own value. Classes matter because a text face carries thousands of readable pairs, and a hand kerned list of that size is unmaintainable. FontLab writes the result into GPOS as class based positioning. kerning pair spacing-corrected pair кернинговая пара proposed ParaType terminology: Kerned pairs = Кернинговые пары; FontForge (ru). Write пара where the English says only pair. A kerning pair associates two glyphs, or two kerning classes, with a spacing adjustment. In horizontal kerning, a negative value normally reduces the gap and a positive value increases it. An individual glyph pair may provide an exception to class kerning, but it can also exist without a class rule. Check pairs in representative text as well as in isolation. left sidebearing левый полуапрош proposed Derived from полуапрош (ParaType terminology); Glyphs abbreviates it ЛПА. Keep numeric controls compact: LSB/RSB (French AG/AD), UPM and PPM. Expanded terms belong in explanatory help; the full Family Dimensions Units Per eM label is an intentional exception. Team UI convention in Proteus 1751b28b0. The horizontal space between the glyph origin and the left edge of its outline. It contributes to the glyph advance width and its spacing. Lib Lib proposed Identifier of the UFO and VFJ data dictionary; kept as in German and Polish. Lib is the custom metadata dictionary of a font or a master, mirroring the UFO lib and stored in VFJ. Scripts and tools keep their own keys there. line gap межстрочный зазор proposed No attestation; plain rendering of the extra space between lines. Rejected: интерлиньяж, which ParaType defines as the whole baseline-to-baseline distance (used here for line height). The line gap is extra vertical space between lines that a font recommends beyond ascender and descender. hhea and OS/2 each store one. line height интерлиньяж proposed ParaType terminology: leading = Интерлиньяж, the distance between the baselines of adjacent lines, which is this definition. Rejected: высота строки (CSS calque). The distance between successive text baselines. It includes the relevant ascender, descender and line-gap contributions; line gap alone is only the additional space. link metrics tie spacing to another glyph связать метрики proposed Glyphs 3 (ru): Link Metrics With Master = Связать метрики с мастером. Link metrics ties a glyph's sidebearing or advance width to another glyph or to an expression, so the value follows its source. FontLab shows linked metrics with the expression and updates them when the source changes. linked metrics связанные метрики proposed Derived from связать метрики. Glyph spacing values linked to another glyph or to an expression. Updating the source or expression changes the dependent advance width or sidebearings. mark attachment combining mark positioning позиционирование диакритики proposed Glyphs 3 (ru): Mark Positioning = Позиционирование диакритики. Mark attachment positions a combining mark relative to a base glyph, a ligature component or another mark. OpenType GPOS lookups describe the anchor relationships, and the shaping engine applies the positioning during layout. FontLab can generate attachment code from suitable anchors. Check the relevant generation settings and test combinations, including stacked marks, rather than assuming that every anchor automatically becomes a lookup. master source design мастер proposed Glyphs 3 (ru), Contrast Foundry, type.today and long-standing FontLab usage; plural мастера. Rejected: образец, мастер-образец (Russian Felici). A master provides source outlines and other font data at a specified location in a design space. Masters can describe weight, width or other variations, including intermediate locations. FontLab uses corresponding data from masters to calculate instances. For outline interpolation, check contour and point compatibility in each affected glyph; the word master alone does not guarantee that every glyph is present or compatible. master compatibility matching master structure совместимость мастеров proposed Glyphs 3 (ru): Master Compatibility = Совместимость мастеров. Master compatibility is the condition every glyph must meet before it can interpolate: the same number of contours in the same order, with the same number of nodes and the same start point in each. FontLab reports incompatible glyphs and gives you Matchmaker to repair them by matching contours and start points between masters. Fix compatibility before you tune shapes, because a repair that reorders nodes moves every curve that depends on them. metrics метрики proposed ParaType terminology, Glyphs 3 (ru), FontForge (ru). Metrics are the measurements that place a glyph in a line: its advance width and its two sidebearings. Vertical metrics are a separate set, the font wide values for ascender, descender, and line gap. You work on horizontal metrics in the Metrics panel and with the Metrics tool, and on vertical metrics in Font Info. Say which set you mean whenever a page discusses both, because a reader who applies a horizontal instruction to the vertical fields breaks line spacing everywhere the font is used. metrics expression выражение метрик proposed Derived from метрики; no attestation. An expression that calculates a glyph advance width or sidebearing from other values. It describes a spacing relationship rather than a canvas measurement. metrics key ключ метрик proposed Glyphs 3 (ru): Metrics keys = Ключ метрик. A glyph reference or expression used to derive a spacing value. The referenced value determines an advance width or sidebearing. pin булавка proposed Issue 160 catalog family review: named point inside an element, distinct from a glyph-layer anchor. Proteus Resources/helptips.json def.anchorpin defines the behavior. Preserve this term across panel, tool, action and help labels; proposed terminology, not native-team approval. A pin is a named point inside an element. Use pins to position elements with expressions and to attach elements to each other. An anchor is a named point in a glyph layer, used for component placement and mark attachment. Create either with the Guides tool and edit it in the Anchors and Pins panel. PPM pixels per type body PPM proposed The Russian guide keeps acronyms that have no established translation. Expand in prose as пикселей на кегельную площадку. Keep numeric controls compact: LSB/RSB (French AG/AD), UPM and PPM. Expanded terms belong in explanatory help; the full Family Dimensions Units Per eM label is an intentional exception. Team UI convention in Proteus 1751b28b0. PPM, pixels per em, is the size at which a rasterizer renders a font: how many pixels one em occupies. TrueType hints, device corrections and bitmap strikes are specified per PPM. In explanatory prose expand it; in hinting fields the short form is usual. production glyph name shipping glyph name техническое имя глифа proposed Glyphs 3 (ru): Production Name = Техническое название. Rejected: производственное имя (calque). A production glyph name is the name written into the exported font, chosen for compatibility with tools and the Adobe Glyph List, such as uni00C1 rather than Aacute. rendering drawing on screen рендеринг proposed Corpus best pick; common in Russian writing on font rasterization. Отрисовка is the plainer alternative. Rendering is the conversion of an outline into pixels on a screen or a printer. The rasterizer of the operating system or of FontLab's preview reads the outline, applies the hints and paints the result. FontLab previews rendering at chosen pixel sizes so you can judge hints. Rasterization names the same step from the pixel side. required glyphs mandatory glyphs обязательные глифы proposed No attestation; fallback translated. Required glyphs are the ones the OpenType specification and common tools expect at the start of a font: .notdef, NULL or uni0000, CR or uni000D and space. FontLab can add them on export. right sidebearing правый полуапрош proposed Derived from полуапрош (ParaType terminology); Glyphs abbreviates it ППА. Keep numeric controls compact: LSB/RSB (French AG/AD), UPM and PPM. Expanded terms belong in explanatory help; the full Family Dimensions Units Per eM label is an intentional exception. Team UI convention in Proteus 1751b28b0. The horizontal space between the right edge of a glyph outline and the end of its advance width. It contributes to spacing. sidebearing side space полуапрош proposed ParaType terminology: Sidebearings = Полуапрош; Glyphs 3 (ru) (Прировнять к полуапрошам). Rejected: апрош, which ParaType calls a common mistake for this. A sidebearing is the space between a glyph's outline and the edge of its advance width: the left sidebearing before the shape, the right sidebearing after it. Together with the advance width it sets how the glyph spaces against every other glyph, which is the work that carries a text face further than kerning does. You edit sidebearings in the Metrics panel or with the Metrics tool, one glyph at a time or across a selection, and you check them in a word rather than in isolation. size размер proposed Glyphs 3 (ru); the type size itself is кегль (ParaType terminology). The size of an object or the chosen size of displayed text. Name a specific width or height when only one direction is intended. spacing апроши proposed ParaType terminology defines апрош as the space between adjacent letters, and designers say расставлять апроши; the activity is расстановка апрошей. Rejected: разрядка (Glyphs; means letterspacing), спейсинг (type.today, jargon), интервал. The adjustment of glyph advance widths and sidebearings to establish the space between letters. Kerning makes additional adjustments to particular pairs. standard stem reference stem width стандартная толщина штриха proposed No attestation; describes StdHW and StdVW, which are widths. FontForge says ширина штрихов, Glyphs стем. Standard stems are the representative horizontal and vertical stem widths declared in a font for hinting. The rasterizer snaps stems near those widths to the same pixel count, so like stems stay alike at small sizes. stem link stem tie связь штриха proposed No attestation; fallback stem tie translated with штрих. A stem link ties two edges of a stroke together as a stem, so hinting can hold their distance as the size changes. A vertical link governs a horizontal measurement and a horizontal link governs a vertical one. You add links in the glyph, either by hand or from an autohinting pass, and you keep them consistent with the standard stem widths declared in Font Info. Vextra reuses the term for the paired edges it detects in artwork that is not type. styling group name название стилевой группы proposed No attestation; compositional. Glyphs renders style linking as связывание стилей. The styling group name, SGN, ties together the styles an application reaches through its bold and italic buttons, and the styling link value and styling link name say which slot each style takes in that group. The mechanism is older than typographic family names and narrower: four slots, no more. You set these fields in TransType when a family has to behave correctly in applications that still drive style selection from those buttons. subsetting cutting down a font создание подмножества proposed FontForge (ru) and Fontmatrix use подмножество for subset. Rejected: поднабор (Font Book). Subsetting exports only part of a font, such as the glyphs a page uses or one codepage, to make a smaller file. The OS/2 embedding bits can forbid it. top sidebearing верхний полуапрош proposed Derived from полуапрош; Glyphs abbreviates it ВПА. The space above the glyph outline within its vertical advance. This value participates in vertical text spacing rather than horizontal spacing. tracking uniform letter spacing трекинг proposed ParaType terminology source pair tracking = Трекинг; Russian Felici; eight corpus origins. Rejected: отслеживание (corpus pick, the surveillance sense). Tracking changes the spacing across a run of text, rather than correcting particular pairs as kerning does. Layout applications apply it to text. TransType's Tracking filter changes spacing in the font data itself. That changes the font's starting metrics; a layout application can still apply additional tracking to text set in the resulting font. TrueType instruction pixel fitting instruction инструкция TrueType proposed ParaType terminology: Instruction = Инструкция (TrueType); Glyphs 3 (ru): TrueType-инструкции. A TrueType instruction is one step of the program a TrueType font runs to fit an outline to the pixel grid. Instructions are the TrueType form of hints. FontLab writes them from visual TrueType hints and can keep the ones a font already has. Say instruction for the code and hint for what the reader draws. typographic family name типографское название семейства proposed Glyphs 3 (ru): Typographic Family Names = Типографские названия семейств. The typographic family name, TFN, is the name that groups every style of a family under one entry, and the typographic style name, TSN, is what distinguishes a style inside it. They sit beside the older four style family and style names that legacy applications read. You set them in TransType and in Font Info, and you keep them consistent across a family, because an app that reads these fields builds its font menu from them. update metrics обновить метрики proposed Glyphs 3 (ru): Update pattern (Обновить ЛПА) with метрики. Recalculate glyph spacing values from their links or expressions. This command updates the advance widths and sidebearings that depend on those relationships. variable font вариативный шрифт proposed Glyphs 3 (ru), type.today and Contrast Foundry. Rejected: меняющийся шрифт (InDesign), переменный шрифт. A variable font contains data for design variation along one or more axes. Applications select axis values and calculate the corresponding outlines and other variable data. Named instances identify selected locations, but users are not limited to those locations when the application exposes axis controls. A variable font's supported range depends on its data; it need not contain every style in the family. variation location position in the variation range положение proposed No attestation; a point in the дизайн-пространство, as German Position and Polish położenie. Write положение в дизайн-пространстве when the context does not name it. Glyphs says расположение оси. A variation location is a point in the design space, given as one value per axis. Masters and instances each have one, and the Variations panel slider shows the current one. vertical advance glyph box height высота площадки proposed Vertical counterpart of ширина площадки; no direct attestation. Rejected: вертикальная ширина (Glyphs, FontForge), an oxymoron. The vertical advance is the distance a glyph advances in vertical text, the counterpart of advance width for East Asian layout. Stored in vmtx. vertical metrics вертикальные метрики proposed Glyphs 3 (ru): Vertical Metrics = Вертикальные метрики. The font-wide vertical values used for line layout, including ascender, descender and line gap. FontLab groups these as dimensions, distinct from glyph spacing metrics. visual kerning shape-measured spacing correction визуальный кернинг proposed Derived from кернинг; no attestation. Visual kerning is kerning that FontLab proposes by measuring the shapes, so that a font gets a usable first pass without a person typing thousands of values. You run it over a selection, then review what it produced, because a measurement of two outlines does not know about the words a reader will meet. Treat the result as a draft: keep the pairs it got right, correct the ones it did not, and kern the difficult pairs by eye in real words. weight axis thickness axis ось насыщенности proposed ParaType terminology (ось насыщенности in the definition of design axis) and Contrast Foundry. The weight axis, tag wght, varies stroke thickness from light to bold. In a variable font it is the most common axis; its master locations use the usWeightClass scale, such as 400 for Regular and 700 for Bold. weight class класс насыщенности proposed Glyphs 3 (ru) and FontForge (ru): Weight Class = Класс насыщенности. The weight class is the OS/2 value from 100 to 900 that tells applications how heavy a style is, with 400 for Regular and 700 for Bold. Style linking and menus rely on it. width axis narrow-to-wide axis ось ширины proposed ParaType terminology (ось ширины in the definition of design axis) and Contrast Foundry. ParaType's плотность names the proportion of a typeface and is not used for the axis. The width axis, tag wdth, varies letter proportions from condensed to extended. It is distinct from advance width, which is the spacing of one glyph, and from the geometric width of a shape. Its scale is a percentage of normal width. width class класс ширины proposed Glyphs 3 (ru): Width Class = Класс ширины. The width class is the OS/2 value from 1, ultra condensed, to 9, ultra expanded, that tells applications how wide a style is. It is a classification, not the width axis value and not the advance width.

docs.title: OpenType
docs.text: English Fallback Russian Status Note Definition Adobe Glyph List Adobe Glyph List do-not-translate The Adobe Glyph List maps standard glyph names to Unicode codepoints, so that a glyph named aacute is understood as U plus 00E1 by any tool that follows it. You name glyphs by it wherever it covers the character, because tools and text engines can then infer the mapping without being told twice. Where it does not cover a glyph, you fall back to a consistent scheme of your own and assign codepoints explicitly. Write the name in full on first mention, then AGL. alternate glyph glyph variant альтернативный глиф proposed ParaType terminology states the pair Alternate glyph = Альтернативный глиф. An alternate glyph is another form of the same character, selected through an OpenType feature such as salt or a stylistic set. Its name usually carries a suffix, as in a.alt or g.ss01. cmap cmap do-not-translate The cmap table maps character codes to glyph indices. Its Unicode subtables provide the initial mapping used in text rendering; other subtables support particular encodings or variation sequences. FontLab generates these mappings from the project's encoding data. A glyph without its own Unicode assignment can still appear in typed text through substitution, such as a ligature or alternate selected by the shaping engine. code page legacy character table кодовая страница proposed ParaType terminology, Glyphs 3 (ru), Microsoft. A code page is a numbered legacy encoding, such as Windows 1250 for Central European languages, that maps one byte to one character. The OS/2 table lists the code pages a font supports, and FontLab derives that list from the glyphs present. Write two words. color font table таблица цветного шрифта proposed No attestation; compositional, with таблица for a font table as in Glyphs and FontForge. Colour-font tables store data for colour glyph rendering. Formats include COLR with CPAL, SVG, sbix, and CBDT with CBLC. They differ in how they describe vector or bitmap content and in application support. Including several formats can extend coverage, but does not guarantee rendering in every application. Identify the exported formats and test the intended targets. contextual alternates context-dependent variants контекстные альтернативы proposed Corpus best pick; derived from альтернатива. Rejected: контекстные альтернейты (Glyphs). Contextual alternates, the calt feature, cover substitutions an app makes because of what sits around a glyph rather than because a reader asked. In a script face the text engine replaces an entry stroke after a letter that already ends in one, and in a face with repeating shapes it replaces the second of a pair. You write the rules with context in feature code, and apps usually leave calt on by default, which makes it the feature most likely to surprise you when a rule is too broad. cursive attachment joined-script connection курсивное присоединение proposed No settled term: FontForge says соединение рукописного письма, Apple рукописное соединение, Glyphs позиционирование курсива. Fallback translated; присоединение is the ParaType word for a joining stroke. Cursive attachment joins glyphs by matching an exit anchor of one glyph to the entry anchor of the next, so connected scripts such as Arabic and Nastaliq flow. It is the curs feature, built from anchors. design languages целевые языки proposed No attestation; follows the reviewed German Zielsprachen and Polish języki docelowe: the languages the typeface was designed for. Design languages, the meta table dlng record, list the languages the typeface was designed for. Supported languages, slng, list every language it can set. Both are language tags, not feature tags. encoding кодировка proposed ParaType terminology (кодировка шрифта), Glyphs 3 (ru), FontForge (ru). An encoding maps character codes to glyphs. Unicode is the encoding modern fonts use; legacy encodings such as Mac Roman or a code page map one byte to one glyph. FontLab shows the font in a chosen encoding in the Font window and writes the cmap from it. Say encoding for the mapping and code page for a numbered legacy table. feature code layout rule code код функций proposed Derived from функция; no attestation. The FEA abbreviation stays. Feature code is the text syntax that describes OpenType features: classes, lookups, substitution and positioning rules, grouped into features by tag. It is usually called FEA, after the file extension. You edit it in the Features panel, compile it to check for errors, and keep it under the same review as the drawings, since a rule that fires on the wrong glyph is as visible as a wrong outline. FontLab compiles it into GSUB and GPOS at export. fractions дроби proposed Glyphs 3 (ru), FontForge (ru), Adobe. Fractions are numerical forms such as ½. In OpenType, the frac feature supports diagonal fraction composition through glyph substitution. A font may provide precomposed fraction glyphs, numerator and denominator forms, or both. The separate numr and dnom features provide numerator and denominator forms. Do not substitute the sups and subs feature names for these mechanisms or promise support for every input sequence without testing it. glyph index glyph number индекс глифа proposed Compositional; standard in Russian OpenType writing. A glyph index is the number a glyph occupies in the font's own order, counting from zero. Text engines work in indices after the cmap has done its job, and binary tables reference glyphs by index rather than by name. You rarely set one by hand, but you meet it when you inspect a compiled font or debug a lookup that fires on the wrong glyph. The index depends on glyph order, so it changes when the order does. glyph name имя глифа proposed FontForge (ru) (имя глифа) and Glyphs 3 (ru) (имя/название глифа); имя suits an identifier, название is kept for family and style names. A glyph name identifies a glyph in an editing project, feature code or a tool's data. Names such as a, a.sc and a.alt can distinguish related drawings. They are separate from Unicode assignments and glyph indices, and need not survive in every exported format. After renaming a glyph, check references in feature code, classes and scripts, including references the editor cannot update automatically. GPOS GPOS do-not-translate GPOS is the OpenType table that holds positioning: kerning, mark attachment, cursive attachment, and any rule that moves a glyph without replacing it. FontLab writes your kerning here, as pairs and as class based positioning, and builds the mark lookups from your anchors. You reach it through feature code rather than by editing the table. A font may also carry a legacy kern table; modern text engines read GPOS and many ignore the other. GSUB GSUB do-not-translate GSUB is the OpenType table containing glyph-substitution lookups. It supports operations such as replacing a glyph with an alternate, forming a ligature or selecting a form from its context. FontLab compiles feature code into these structures. To diagnose a missing substitution, check the glyphs, compiled rules, feature selection, language and shaping order in the target application. ligature joined letters лигатура proposed ParaType terminology, Glyphs 3 (ru), Adobe. A ligature is a glyph used to represent a sequence of characters, such as fi. OpenType substitution can replace several glyphs with one ligature glyph. The liga and dlig features distinguish standard and discretionary ligatures. Shaping does not change the underlying text; whether a later document export preserves searchable text also depends on that export and its text mappings. localized forms language-specific variants локализованные формы proposed Corpus best pick. Rejected: локализированные формы (Glyphs). Localized forms are glyph variants selected for a text run's language. The OpenType locl feature can provide these substitutions, for example Bulgarian forms of Cyrillic letters. The shaping engine needs the relevant language information, which the application may obtain from a setting or other context. The substitution changes glyph selection, not the underlying characters or their codepoints. lookup procedure процедура approved Explicit user/team decision: процедура; feature remains функция and individual rule remains правило. Inflect as a feminine noun. Keep the approved contextual Rules panel title. Preserve literal FEA lookup/lookupflag keywords, identifiers and OpenType structure names. Ordinary search senses are separate. A lookup groups substitution or positioning rules of one type in GSUB or GPOS. Features reference lookups, and several features can share one. The shaping engine selects features and may process them in script-specific stages; within a stage, LookupList order matters. Source-code order alone does not describe the complete shaping sequence. Inspect the compiled tables and the target engine when diagnosing ordering problems. mark glyph combining mark glyph глиф диакритики proposed Derived from диакритика and глиф; no attestation. A mark glyph is an accent or other combining mark that attaches to a base glyph through anchors. The GDEF table classes it as a mark so shaping engines position it rather than advancing past it. nonspacing mark zero-width combining mark диакритика нулевой ширины proposed No settled term; fallback translated. Rejected: непробельный (Glyphs category name), which reads as not whitespace. A nonspacing mark is the Unicode general category Mn: a combining mark with zero advance, such as a combining acute. It differs from FontLab's nonspacing element, which is a property of an element inside a glyph. oldstyle figures lowercase-style figures минускульные цифры proposed ParaType terminology: Text figures = Минускульные цифры, the pair of маюскульные. Rejected: старостильные цифры (Glyphs, Adobe), цифры старого стиля. Oldstyle figures are numerals with varying heights, often including forms with ascenders and descenders. The OpenType onum feature selects them when provided by the font. Figure height and figure width are separate choices: oldstyle figures can be proportional or tabular. Use tabular widths when numerals must align in columns, whether their forms are oldstyle or lining. OpenType class layout glyph group класс OpenType proposed Compositional; Glyphs and FontForge use класс. An OpenType class is a named group of glyphs that feature code can address at once, written with an at sign before the name. One rule over two classes replaces a page of single rules, and one edit to a class reaches every rule that cites it. You define classes in the Classes panel or in feature code, and you keep their order stable, because a substitution between two classes pairs them by position. Kerning classes are a separate mechanism with the same idea. OpenType feature layout feature функция OpenType proposed FontForge (ru): Merge Feature Info = Вставить функции OpenType. Rejected: OpenType-фича (Glyphs, type.today), slang; возможность OpenType. An OpenType feature identifies typographic behaviour through a four-character tag, such as liga, smcp or ss01. Feature records reference substitution or positioning lookups. In FontLab, you can write feature code and compile it into the font. Whether and when a feature is applied depends on the shaping engine, script, language and application settings; not every feature is a user-controlled switch. OS/2 table таблица OS/2 proposed Tag protected, noun translated; Glyphs pattern таблица + tag. The OS/2 table carries the font's metadata for applications: vertical metrics, weight and width classes, embedding permissions, the panose values, and the codepage and Unicode range bits that say what the font covers. You fill it from Font Info rather than by hand, and you check it before release, because a wrong weight class puts a font in the wrong slot in a menu and wrong vertical metrics change line spacing in every browser. Write it with the slash: OS/2. Private Use Area Private Use Area do-not-translate A private-use area is one of three Unicode blocks whose codepoints can receive meanings by private agreement. Different fonts or systems may assign different meanings to the same private-use codepoint. Use a documented agreement when encoding custom symbols there. An alternate glyph reached through a feature does not require its own private-use assignment. single substitution единичная подстановка proposed FontForge (ru): Single Substitution = Единичная подстановка. A single substitution replaces one glyph with one other glyph, the simplest GSUB lookup type. Small caps, stylistic alternates and localized forms are mostly built from it. small caps small capitals капитель proposed ParaType terminology source pair small caps = Капитель; Glyphs 3 (ru), Fontmatrix, Russian Felici. Rejected: малые прописные (Apple, FontForge). Small caps are capital shapes drawn at roughly lowercase height, with their own weight and width rather than scaled capitals. Apps apply the smcp feature to put them in place of lowercase letters, and c2sc to put them in place of capitals, so a run set in both features becomes uniform. You draw them as separate glyphs, usually with a dot sc suffix, and write both features. Scaled capitals look thin beside real text, which is the reason to draw them rather than let an app fake them. stylistic set стилистический набор proposed Attested in the corpus and usual on Russian foundry sites. Rejected: набор стилей (Adobe; reads as a set of styles). A stylistic set is a numbered group of alternate glyphs a reader can switch on, from ss01 through ss20. Each set holds alternates that belong together: a single storey a with a matching g, a set of flat topped figures. You name each set in the font so an app can show a readable label instead of a number, and you keep one idea per set. A set that mixes unrelated alternates gives a reader nothing they can decide about. tabular figures equal-width figures табличные цифры proposed ParaType terminology: Tabular figures = Табличные цифры; Glyphs 3 (ru). Tabular figures all carry the same advance width, so columns of numbers line up whatever digits they contain. Apps apply the tnum feature to put them in place of proportional figures. You draw them as a separate set and give every one the same width, centring the narrow digits inside it. They matter in any table, price list, or running total, and they look loose in prose, which is why a font offers both sets rather than choosing for the reader. Unicode codepoint character code кодовая позиция Юникода proposed Кодовая позиция is the usual term in Russian Unicode references; ParaType, Glyphs, FontForge and Apple write Юникод. Rejected: кодовая точка (FontForge). Compact form: код Юникода. A Unicode codepoint is an integer from U+0000 to U+10FFFF. Not every codepoint has an assigned character. Write it with U+ and at least four hexadecimal digits, as in U+0041 for A. In a font editor, a glyph's Unicode assignment connects it to an encoded character; the exported cmap records the relevant mapping. variation selector variant picker character селектор вариаций proposed FontForge (ru) writes селекторы вариаций in running text (and вариантные селекторы for the Unicode block). A variation selector is a Unicode character that follows a base character to request a specific glyph form. The pair is a variation sequence, mapped in the cmap format 14 subtable; a default mapping points at the base glyph. writing system система письма proposed ParaType terminology uses система письма in its definition of шрифт; corpus best pick. Glyphs письменность is the word for script. A writing system is the set of characters and rules a language writes with, such as Latin, Cyrillic or Arabic. OpenType calls it a script and identifies it by a four letter tag. Say writing system in prose and script tag for the identifier, so the reader does not confuse it with a Python script.

docs.title: File formats
docs.text: English Fallback Russian Status Note Definition AI file AI file do-not-translate An AI file is an Adobe Illustrator document, and it is the container the Vexy Illustrator plug-ins work inside. It holds paths, strokes, fills, appearances, and the live effects that a plug-in adds. You do not export an AI file from the plug-ins; you work in one. Write it as an AI file or an Illustrator document, never as an ai, and name Adobe Illustrator in full on first mention in the same document. AIP AIP do-not-translate An AIP file is an Adobe Illustrator plug-in binary, and it is how Vexy Linestra and Vexy Vextra reach Illustrator. The filenames close up the product name, VexyLinestra.aip and VexyVextra.aip, while prose keeps the space. You copy the file into the Illustrator plug-ins folder, whose name the operating system may show translated, and restart Illustrator so it loads. Name the file exactly as it ships, since a renamed plug-in does not load. FLREQ FLREQ do-not-translate An FLREQ file is a licence request the application writes when a machine cannot reach the licensing service, and an FLLIC file is the response that activates it. You send the request from the machine that needs the licence, receive the response, and open it there. The pair exists for machines that stay offline, so name both files in a procedure that uses either, and say which machine each step happens on. Fog.net Fog.net do-not-translate Fog.net is Fontographer's project data format, and fognet is the Python module that reads and writes it from a script. A project file carries the extension .fog. You meet the format when you script against a project or move one between machines, rather than in ordinary editing, where the dashboard handles saving. The module name is lowercase, as Python module names are, and it goes in code font wherever it appears in prose. Glyphs file Glyphs file do-not-translate A Glyphs file is the source format of the Glyphs editor, and FontLab reads and writes it so that a project can move between the two. It holds masters, glyphs, metrics, and features in one text file. You use it when a collaborator works in the other editor, and you check the result after the trip, because two editors model masters and components in ways that do not correspond exactly. Write it as a Glyphs file, not as a glyphs. Lines file Lines file do-not-translate A Lines file is the native document of Vexy Lines, holding the source image, the fills applied to it, and the settings that produced the result. You save to it while you work and export vector artwork when you are finished, because the export keeps the result and not the recipe. Write it as a Lines file with a capital L when you name the format, and as the extension in lowercase with a dot when you mean the file suffix. OTF OTF do-not-translate OTF is the usual filename extension for an OpenType font with PostScript outlines. These use cubic curves stored in CFF or CFF2 data. State the outline flavour when it matters: OpenType fonts with TrueType outlines also support OpenType layout features. The .otf extension alone does not establish which features, colour formats or variation capabilities a font contains. SVG SVG do-not-translate SVG is the vector graphics format, and it names two different things in this documentation: a graphic file that a drawing tool exports, and the SVG table inside a colour font. Say which you mean. You export SVG artwork from the Vexy products, and you meet the SVG table when you build a colour font in FontLab. A sentence that says SVG support without saying which one leaves a reader to guess. TTC TTC do-not-translate TTC is the usual filename extension for a TrueType font collection: several fonts stored in one file. Collection members can share tables, reducing duplication where their data is identical. A collection is a packaging format, not an interpolation model. Distinguish its individual fonts from named instances within a variable font. TTF TTF do-not-translate TTF is the usual filename extension for a font with TrueType outlines, which use quadratic curves. An OpenType TTF can contain layout features and variation data. Exporting cubic source outlines to this flavour requires curve conversion, which can change the point structure and approximate the original geometry. Check the exported outlines at the intended sizes. Type 1 Type 1 do-not-translate Type 1 is an older PostScript outline-font format. It remains relevant when opening archived fonts or explaining conversion workflows. Support depends on the application and version, so identify the target when discussing compatibility. Converting a Type 1 font to OpenType does not automatically supply missing Unicode mappings or new layout features. UFO UFO do-not-translate UFO, Unified Font Object, is an open source-font format. UFO 3 stores glyph layers, font information, kerning, groups and optional feature code in a directory package or ZIP archive. It also allows images and application-specific data. Interchange depends on what both applications support; a UFO export does not by itself guarantee that every editor-specific property survives. VFB VFB do-not-translate VFB is the native source format of FontLab Studio 5. FontLab 8 can open and export it, but the format cannot represent every feature of a FontLab 8 project. Use VFC or VFJ for ongoing work in FontLab 8. Name VFB when explaining migration or an exchange workflow that requires the older format, and check the exported result for unsupported data. VFC VFC do-not-translate VFC is FontLab's native binary format, and the one you work in. It holds everything the editor knows: masters, elements, references, anchors, kerning, features, and the project settings that no font format carries. You save to it while you design and export to OTF or TTF when you ship. Write the format in capitals when you name it and in lowercase with a dot when you mean the extension. Its sibling VFJ stores the same content as text. VFJ VFJ do-not-translate VFJ is FontLab's JSON source format. It provides a text representation of a FontLab project for workflows that need readable or scriptable data. Use it as a source format, not an installable font. When exchanging files between FontLab versions or external tools, check that the receiving tool supports the data the project uses. WOFF2 WOFF2 do-not-translate WOFF2 is a compressed font format for web delivery. Its encoding uses font-specific transformations and Brotli compression. Export it for web use and test the resulting font in the target browsers. The size saving depends on the source font and its contents; do not promise a fixed reduction or infer available features from the extension.

docs.title: Interface
docs.text: English Fallback Russian Status Note Definition action действие proposed Apple, Adobe and Microsoft Russian all use действие; операция is the rejected alternative. An action is an operation you can invoke in the application. An action label names the operation; help explains its effect. add добавить proposed Glyphs 3 (ru) and FontForge (ru) use Добавить; standard platform verb. Add inserts another item into the current collection or selection. Name the item when the surrounding control does not make it clear. alternate альтернатива proposed ParaType site writes стилистические и контекстуальные альтернативы; Glyphs Стилистические альтернативы. Rejected: альтернейт (Glyphs jargon). An alternate is a different glyph form for the same character or purpose. The context determines how you select or substitute that form. anchor cloud attachment point cloud облако якорей proposed No attestation; compound derived from якорь. Where the English says only cloud, write облако. The anchor cloud previews the marks that attach to an anchor by showing them faintly around the glyph in the Glyph window. It checks mark positioning without leaving the base glyph. auto layer recipe-built layer автослой proposed No attestation; closed compound derived from слой, like Polish autowarstwa. An auto layer builds a glyph from a recipe, such as A plus acute, and rebuilds it when the parts change. Turn auto off to edit the glyph by hand. autohint автохинтинг proposed Command label as a noun, same word as the process; in a sentence write выполнить автохинтинг. ParaType source pair Auto-hinting = Автохинтинг; Glyphs labels the command Автохинтовка. Autohint is the command to generate hints automatically. Use autohinting when naming the process rather than the command. Brush Кисть proposed Adobe, Glyphs and every Russian graphics application. The Brush tool draws a stroke freehand, and what the stroke becomes differs by product. In FontLab and Fontographer the Brush keeps the path you drew as a centreline and generates the thick outline from it, so the drawing stays editable until you expand it into ordinary contours. In Vexy Lines the Brush paints masks by hand, and a mask decides where a layer's fills can draw rather than being artwork itself. Name the application in any sentence where a reader could take one tool for the other. collapse схлопнуть proposed The definition is to pull selected nodes into one point, not to fold a panel; схлопнуть is attested in the corpus for exactly that. Rejected: свернуть (folds interface elements). Collapse aligns the selected nodes to one point. In the Contour tool it aligns both coordinates; in the Metrics tool only the horizontal one. It moves nodes; it does not merge them. color flag color mark цветная метка proposed Glyphs 3 (ru): Color Label = Цветные метки; where the English says only flag, write метка. Rejected: флажок (means checkbox in Russian UI). A color flag is a color you assign to a glyph cell, a kerning pair or a class to mark it for later. Flags are annotations for the designer and are not exported. corner angles углы в вершинах proposed No attestation; describes the definition (angles at contour vertices). The angles at contour vertices. These geometric measurements describe how adjacent segments meet at a corner and can be displayed on the canvas. cousins related glyphs alongside родня proposed House voice: a plain collective noun for the family, like Polish kuzynostwo; it avoids the bookish кузены. No attestation. Cousins are related glyphs or other masters that FontLab shows faintly around the current glyph in the Glyph window, so you can compare shapes and spacing while you edit. The name is FontLab's, rendered in each language's house voice. crop обрезать proposed Glyphs 3 (ru) (Обрезать изображение) and Adobe. Rejected: кадрировать (photo sense only). Crop trims an image or drawing to a chosen area. The command label names the operation; its context identifies the object being cropped. cubic кубический proposed ParaType terminology (кубическая кривая) and FontForge (ru); inflect for the noun. A cubic Bézier segment is a curve defined by two endpoints and two control points. Cubic describes the degree of the curve, not its physical dimensions. current текущий proposed Standard in all Russian software; inflect for the noun. Current identifies the item or state active at the time of an operation. Name the item, such as the current layer, when the context is ambiguous. cusp излом proposed Contrast Foundry writes излом for the abrupt break in a contour; keeps cusp apart from острый (sharp). No editor attestation. A cusp is a sharp point where a curve changes direction abruptly. Keep it distinct from a smooth join. decompose break into contours разложить proposed Glyphs 3 (ru): Decompose = Разложить (Разложить компоненты). Rejected: разобрать, used here for expand. Decompose replaces components with copies of their contours, so the glyph no longer follows its source glyphs. Use it before edits that a component cannot carry, or before export to a format without composites. default по умолчанию proposed Platform standard; Glyphs and FontForge. A default is the value or choice used when no explicit alternative has been selected. It need not be the currently selected value. demo mode демо-режим proposed Common Russian software usage; no font-specific attestation. Demo mode is how FontLab runs without a license: everything works except saving, exporting and printing. dialog диалоговое окно proposed Platform standard (Apple, Microsoft, Qt). Rejected: диалог (colloquial). A dialog presents information, settings or a question for a particular interaction. A modal dialog restricts interaction with its parent until it is dismissed; a modeless dialog does not. Use the application's established name and reproduce its button labels exactly. If a procedure opens a dialog, explain the relevant choices and how to apply or cancel them. Dream Up generate shapes Наколдовать proposed House voice, like Polish wyczaruj: conjure up. No attestation; Dream Up Font is Наколдовать шрифт. Dream Up is a Fontographer command for generating glyph shapes. Dream Up Font generates a whole font; Mixfont blends existing fonts. Keep these commands distinct and show any confirmed cost before the reader runs an operation. Generated shapes may need further editing. echo text repeated text эхо текста proposed No attestation; keeps the echo image and stays as short as the English. Echo text makes a preview repeat the text of the current window, so the Preview panel or the TrueType hinting preview shows the same string you are editing. Eraser Ластик proposed Adobe and every Russian graphics application. Rejected: резинка. The Eraser removes or simplifies points on a contour. In FontLab, its modes remove nodes and handles, select points for removal, or simplify a path. In Vexy Vextra, normal Eraser removes covered points; Soft Eraser removes a node only when a replacement curve is close enough to the original. That does not guarantee an identical outline. In Fontographer, Eraser shares a grouped toolbar button with Trowel. Name the application and mode when describing an operation. expand filter bake filter into contours разобрать фильтр proposed Adobe Illustrator Russian renders Expand as Разобрать and Glyphs has Expand Outline = Разобрать; the result is plain contours. Expand filter bakes a live element filter, such as Smart Corners, Skin or a boolean Fusion, into plain contours. The filter parameters are no longer editable afterwards. expand stroke bake stroke into contours разобрать обводку proposed Adobe Illustrator and Glyphs Разобрать for Expand. Rejected: расширить обводку (Inkscape), which says the stroke gets wider. Expand stroke converts a stroked centerline, or a brush applied to a contour, into plain filled contours. The live stroke or brush is gone afterwards and the result can be edited node by node. expand transformation bake transformation into contours применить трансформацию proposed Разобрать does not fit a transformation; применить is what Russian graphics software says for baking a transform. No font-editor attestation. Expand transformation writes an element's live transformation, such as scaling or rotation, into the node coordinates. The element then has an identity transformation and its contours carry the geometry directly. feature функция proposed FontForge (ru): Feature = Функция, Feature Tag = Тег функции. Rejected: фича (Glyphs, type.today), slang for a UI; ParaType site writes особенности шрифта. A feature in OpenType editing identifies typographic behavior implemented by substitution or positioning lookups. Feature tags are literal identifiers and remain unchanged in translation. Fills Заливки proposed Adobe and Glyphs use заливка for fill. Rejected: заполнение. In FontLab, the Fill tool sets enclosed regions as filled or unfilled by changing contour direction or applying a live Fill filter. In Vexy Lines, Linestra and Playlines, a fill mode is a method for generating artwork from an image, such as Halftone or Stipple. Name the application and distinguish the tool, the filled region and the generative mode. FontAudit ФонтАудит approved User requires phonetic transliteration, explicitly including Chinese. Russian and Ukrainian spellings were recovered from team QPH; other spellings are proposals. Retain the FontAudit identity; do not translate as a generic audit command. Preserve FontAudit in code and identifiers. FontAudit is the FontLab panel that inspects outlines and reports the problems a proof will show later: unclosed contours, wrong winding directions, missing extreme nodes, near vertical segments, and the like. You run it over a glyph or a selection, read the findings, and fix what matters for the design rather than clearing every warning. In English write the FontAudit panel on first mention. Localized UI may transliterate the name into its writing system; keep the name distinct from a generic audit command. Preserve FontAudit in code and identifiers. FontLab account учетная запись FontLab proposed Translate the common noun account and inflect it in complete sentences; preserve the FontLab brand. German, Spanish and French wording is already used in current FontLab UI. Other language forms are proposals. Do not duplicate account when the surrounding sentence already translates it. Russian guide uses е except disambiguation and proper names; decline учетная запись while preserving FontLab. A FontLab account is the identity used to sign in to FontLab services and manage licences. Keep the capital L in FontLab and lowercase account in English. Translate the common noun account while preserving the FontLab name. Distinguish the account from a licence, subscription or payment when more than one appears in the same explanation. Fusion Welder Сварщик proposed User decision 2026-10-04: translate the fallback Welder, the named live boolean group filter. Polish Spawacz is explicit; other renderings are proposals. Preserve Fusion in code identifiers. Fusion is FontLab's live boolean filter on an element group: add, subtract, intersect or exclude the overlapping contours while the parts stay editable. Intersect keeps only the overlap; expand the filter to bake the result. Genius node self-balancing node узел-гений proposed House voice, concept named rather than kept English; no attestation. Compact label: Гений. A Genius node keeps its curves smooth and balanced automatically when neighbours move; FontLab adjusts its handles for you. A Follower node follows key nodes under Power Nudge. Both are FontLab names, rendered in each language's house voice. grid сетка proposed ParaType terminology, Glyphs 3 (ru), Adobe. A grid is a set of regularly spaced reference lines or points used to position drawing objects. Keep it distinct from a mesh used for deformation. Groups Группы proposed Glyphs 3 (ru): Kerning Groups = группы кернинга; general word группа. A group collects several things and treats them as one, and the things differ by product. In FontLab the word most often means a kerning group, the set of glyphs that kern alike, which the documentation also calls a kerning class. In Vexy Vextra, following Illustrator, a group is selected artwork bound into one object. In Vexy Lines a group bundles layers and carries its own source image, working like a folder. TransType adds a styling group that ties a family's styles into a menu. Say which you mean. guide направляющая proposed Adobe, Apple and Glyphs 3 (ru) (Заменить направляющую). Rejected: гайд (Glyphs slang). A guide is a reference line used to position or align drawing objects. Its name describes its role rather than a visible stroke in the exported glyph. kerning mode режим кернинга proposed Derived from кернинг; no attestation. The editing mode for adjusting spacing between pairs of glyphs. It changes pair adjustments rather than the individual glyph sidebearings. Knife Нож proposed Glyphs 3 (ru) and Adobe. The Knife tool works along a line you drag across a shape, and what it leaves behind differs by product and by sub-tool. In FontLab it adds nodes where the line crosses a contour, breaks a closed contour into open paths, or slices one contour into two closed shapes, depending on which of its three sub-tools is active. In Fontographer it cuts through contours along the drawn path. In Vexy Lines it inserts points and splits curves. Say which app, which mode, and what the cut leaves. layer слой proposed Universal in Russian graphics software. A layer holds one drawing or part of a document. In FontLab, the context identifies the glyph layer; name the application when another product uses a different layer model. Layers Слои proposed Universal in Russian graphics software. Layers hold the separate drawings a glyph or a document carries at once. In FontLab a glyph layer holds one master, a mask, or a background, and you manage them in the Layers and Masters panel, where switching layers switches which drawing you edit. In Vexy Lines a layer is a transparent sheet holding one or more fills, and it is the basic unit of a document, since artwork needs at least one. The two meanings sit close enough to be mistaken, so a sentence about layers names the application. mark диакритика proposed Glyphs 3 (ru): Mark = Диакритика, Marks = Диакритики. Rejected: знак, отметка (FontForge), which lose the positioning sense. A mark in glyph positioning is a diacritical glyph positioned in relation to another glyph. A color mark or selection mark is a different interface meaning. Masks Маски proposed Glyphs 3 (ru) and Adobe use маска. A mask holds a second drawing, and what it does with that drawing differs by product. In FontLab a mask is a glyph layer carrying a previous version or a reference shape, so you can compare the live outline against it and copy between them; it hides nothing. In Vexy Lines a mask is a vector stencil that decides where a layer's fills can draw, letting the fill through its transparent areas and holding it back elsewhere. Name the application, and in FontLab prefer the full phrase mask layer. match согласовать proposed No fixed term; согласовать covers making properties or masters correspond. Rejected: совпадение (corpus pick, a noun for search matches), синхронизировать (longer). Match makes selected properties correspond. The object and context determine whether this means synchronizing edits, matching geometry or comparing values. matching соответствующий proposed Plain adjective for things that correspond; inflect for the noun. Rejected: совпадает с (corpus pick, a filter phrase). Matching describes objects or properties that correspond. Name the matched property when the interface context does not identify it. Matchmaker master matcher Сваха proposed House voice: the village matchmaker, like Polish Swatka. No attestation. Matchmaker is a FontLab tool for examining and correcting correspondence between glyph masters. It helps align contour order and start points for interpolation. Matching structures does not guarantee that intermediate outlines look right. Inspect the resulting interpolation; changing contour order or a start point can change correspondence without changing the outline's geometry at the master location. measurement line линия измерения proposed Derived from измерения; no attestation. A line that shows a measured distance in the drawing. Distinguish this geometric measurement from a metrics line used to calculate sidebearings. measurements измерения proposed Glyphs 3 (ru): Show Measurements = Показать измерения. Values displayed on the canvas to describe geometry, such as coordinates, lengths, angles, tensions and counters. Showing measurements does not modify glyph spacing or font dimensions. Measurements panel панель «Измерения» proposed Derived from измерения (Glyphs 3 (ru): Show Measurements = Показать измерения). The Measurements panel lists measured dimensions of the current font: stems, serifs, overshoots, contrast and heights, separately for capitals and lowercase. Its labels are compact; translations must not exceed the English length. merge объединить proposed Corpus best pick; Adobe and Apple. Rejected: слить (version-control sense). Merge combines items into a result. Name the items and explain what is retained when that distinction matters to the operation. mesh меш proposed Loan attested in four corpus origins; keeps mesh apart from сетка (grid). A reviewer may prefer сетка деформации. A mesh is a network of connected points or cells used to describe or deform geometry. It is distinct from a drawing grid used for alignment. metrics mode режим метрик proposed Derived from метрики; no attestation. The editing mode for adjusting glyph advance widths and sidebearings. It changes the spacing of glyphs rather than the vertical dimensions of the font or the visibility of measurements. metrics table таблица метрик proposed Derived from метрики; no attestation. The table of glyph spacing values, including advance widths and sidebearings. It lets the user inspect or edit spacing values together. metrics tool инструмент «Метрики» proposed Derived from метрики; Russian names a tool in quotes after инструмент. The tool that edits glyph advance widths and sidebearings. Use it to adjust glyph spacing; canvas measurement overlays display values without changing those spacing values. monospaced моноширинный proposed ParaType terminology: Моноширинный шрифт; Apple, Adobe. Monospaced describes text or a typeface whose ordinary spacing glyphs have equal advance widths. Marks and special glyphs can have different spacing behavior. multi-line многострочный proposed Standard Russian software term; inflect for the noun. Multi-line describes text or a control that contains more than one line. It does not imply more than one paragraph. nonspacing zero-width вне метрик proposed No attestation; describes the FontLab meaning (ignored when the advance and sidebearings are computed). Rejected: непробельный (Glyphs, the Unicode category) and нулевой ширины (the element has a width). A nonspacing element or component is excluded from metrics: it stays visible and is exported, but FontLab ignores it when it computes the advance width and sidebearings. Detect nonspacing marks accents and other marks in composites automatically. Nudge push move Подвижка proposed House voice: a plain workshop word for a small shift. No attestation. Rejected: толчок (corpus pick; colloquially also the toilet), сдвиг (too generic, used for any offset). Nudge moves the selected nodes and adjusts the nearby handles so the curve keeps its shape. Power Nudge extends the move to more of the contour. Both are FontLab names. Oblique Oblique proposed Fixed name of the FontLab action, kept as in German and Polish. The design itself is наклонное начертание (ParaType: наклонный шрифт) and a plain slant is наклон. Oblique is FontLab's action that slants a layer and applies a fixed set of optical corrections, so the result is closer to a designed oblique than a plain skew. Keep the name in every language; a plain slant is something else. panel панель proposed Glyphs 3 (ru) and platform standard. Illustrator's own panels are палитра. A panel groups related controls or information within an application's interface. It may be docked or floating, depending on the application. Use its displayed name followed by panel in lowercase, as in the Kerning panel. Distinguish panels, windows, dialogs and panes by their role and established product terminology, not solely by whether they float, dock or contain tabs. Pencil Карандаш proposed Glyphs 3 (ru) and Adobe. The Pencil tool draws freehand, and what it draws on differs by product. In FontLab it converts a freehand gesture into curves and line segments without asking you to think about node types. In Fontographer it is one of three outline drawing tools, beside Pen and Rapid. In Vexy Lines it creates and edits Handmade fills as vector lines. In Vexy Vextra it is the Correcting Pencil, which redraws part of an existing path as readily as it starts a new one. Power Brush power calligraphic brush Суперкисть proposed House voice: супер- carries the energy-drink wink in a closed compound; no attestation. Rejected: мощная кисть, силовая кисть (industrial), турбокисть. A Power Brush is a brush whose width can vary along the contour through thickness points. It stays live until you expand it. The name is FontLab's, rendered in each language's house voice. Power Guide power guideline Супернаправляющая proposed House voice, derived from направляющая with супер-; no attestation. A Power Guide is a guide that nodes can link to, so moving the guide moves the linked nodes with it. FontLab uses it to keep a stem or a height consistent across a glyph. Each language renders the name with the same playful power. Power Nudge power push move Суперподвижка proposed House voice, derived from Подвижка with супер-; no attestation. Power Nudge distributes a move through a larger part of a contour by adjusting other nodes as well as the selected ones. FontLab and Vextra provide this editing mode. It differs from Nudge, which adjusts nearby handles. Power Nudge changes the geometry; inspect the result rather than promising an exactly preserved outline or a finished curve. Power Stroke power stroke outline Суперобводка proposed House voice, derived from обводка with супер-; no attestation. Rejected: крупные мазки (Inkscape path effect, another thing). A Power Stroke is a stroke whose thickness varies along the path, controlled by thickness points you place with the Thickness tool. The related Power Brush does the same for a brush. Both are FontLab names, rendered in each language's house voice. project проект approved Team agreement recovered from Proteus QPH on 2026-10-04. Project names the editable document; do not replace it with package. A FontLab project is the editable font document, including the active document in save/close prompts and the document saved to a VFJ/VFC file or project folder or connected to GitHub. Use the project term consistently in this UI. Do not call it a package. Python packages, UFO Packages, Glyphs Packages, and web-font distribution packages are different concepts and retain their format/software terminology. Internal package identifiers and file extensions are not translated. property bar панель свойств proposed CorelDRAW Russian calls its property bar панель свойств; platform-neutral. The property bar is FontLab's context-sensitive strip of controls for the current tool or selection. Name the required selection or tool before referring to a control that appears only in that context. Use property bar for this product element; do not invent a universal rule that all toolbars have fixed contents. quick measurement быстрое измерение proposed Derived from измерения; no attestation. The function that displays measurements near the pointer while editing outlines. It reports geometry on the canvas without changing the glyph spacing values. redo вернуть proposed FontForge (ru) and Microsoft Office Russian use Вернуть, which leaves повторить for Repeat. Apple and Glyphs say Повторить; follow the platform catalog where Qt supplies the command. Redo reapplies an operation that was undone. Repeat invokes an operation again and is a separate command. reference ссылка proposed FontForge (ru): References = Ссылки. Rejected: привязка, эталон. A reference points to another object rather than being an independent copy of it. Name the referenced object when the context does not identify it. Remove Overlap merge overlapping contours удалить наложение proposed Glyphs 3 (ru): Remove Overlap = Удалить наложение. Rejected: удалить перекрытие (FontForge). Remove Overlap combines overlapping filled contour regions and removes their internal boundaries. It changes contour structure, so keep an editable source when the construction matters. Variable fonts can contain overlaps; removing them independently from masters can break point correspondence and interpolation. Apply the command or export option for the intended format and workflow, rather than treating it as mandatory for every font. repeat повторить proposed Standard verb; Redo is вернуть so that the two stay distinct. Repeat invokes an operation again. Keep it distinct from Redo, which restores an operation after Undo. reverse contour flip drawing direction реверс контура proposed Glyphs 3 (ru): Reverse Contour = Реверс контура. Rejected: развернуть контур (reads as expand), перевернуть (flip). Reverse contour flips the winding direction of a contour. PostScript and TrueType outlines use opposite conventions, and a contour that runs the wrong way fills or unfills the wrong region. Scissors Ножницы proposed Adobe and corpus best pick. The Scissors tool works on the joins in a path, and what it does with them differs by product. In FontLab it disconnects nodes into overlapping contours, creates overlaps, adds simple ink traps, and builds looped corners, with a toolbox of sub-tools under the Q shortcut. In Fontographer it breaks contours at selected points or segments, the targeted counterpart to Knife. In Vexy Vextra it extends and rebuilds path parts, building loop corners and joining open ends. Servant node Follower node ведомый узел proposed Ведомый is the Russian technical word for the one that follows a ведущий, which is the Follower meaning. No attestation. Compact label: Ведомый. For localization, read the legacy English source label Servant node as Follower node: a follower physically following a leader. This node follows the movement of neighboring key nodes when you move them with Power Nudge, so a whole feature moves together. Translate the motion-following role; the servant and social fan/supporter metaphors are obsolete. The English term and servant-node identifier remain compatibility lookup keys. Sigma Sigma do-not-translate Sigma is the Fontographer tool for variable font interpolation paths, sitting in the toolbar beside Transform and Meter. You use it to work with how a design moves through its variation space rather than to edit a single outline. The name is a single capitalized word and it does not take the word tool inside its name: write the Sigma tool. It is a Fontographer term with no counterpart in the other products. Sketchboard scratch canvas Эскизник proposed House voice: an artist's sketchbook, cognate with Polish szkicownik. No attestation. Rejected: скетчборд, монтажная область (Adobe artboard). The Sketchboard is FontLab's unlimited canvas, a working surface where you can place glyphs, drawings, and reference images side by side outside the fixed frame of a glyph window. You use it to compare shapes, to sketch before committing, and to lay out material that has no single glyph to live in. The name is one word, capital S, and it is a FontLab term: no other product in the family has the surface or the word. Skin wrapping outline Шкурка proposed House voice: the diminutive, as the peel of a fruit, like Polish skórka. No attestation. Rejected: кожа (corpus pick, anatomy), оболочка (neutral option). Skin is a FontLab live filter that wraps a contour with a stroke of variable thickness, or cuts it into dashes. Expand the filter to get plain contours. Each language renders the name in the house voice. smart clever хитрый proposed House voice: the plain word for sly or clever; inflect normally. Rejected: умный (the smart-device word), интеллектуальный, смарт (Glyphs), смекалистый (long). Exception: Smart Filter uses умный фильтр by the team decision in Proteus 445b877b3; retain the existing adjective for other Smart features. Smart prefixes FontLab features that decide details for you: Smart Corner, Smart Filter, Smart Pencil, Smart Link, smart fill. Usually translate the word as clever with a hint of cunning. Follow separately approved feature names: the Russian and Ukrainian Smart Filter terms are explicit exceptions. Smart Corner clever corner хитрый угол proposed Derived from хитрый; no attestation. A Smart Corner is a live treatment applied at a node, so a corner can be rounded, cut, or turned into an ink trap without the outline being redrawn. The treatment stays editable: change the value and the corner updates, and the underlying contour keeps its nodes. You apply it at the node rather than to the whole contour. FontLab groups it with Ink Traps among its live filters, and Vextra carries the same name. Smart Filter умный фильтр approved Named glyph-selection filter; not a graphical live effect. Match this term in the Font window, Aidus settings, dialogs and help. Team decision in Proteus 445b877b3, 4 October 2026. This feature-specific exception does not rename other Smart features. A Smart Filter selects glyphs in the Font window using a saved condition. It filters the glyph list rather than changing outlines or applying graphical effects.
