Expanded terms belong in explanatory help; the full Family Dimensions Units Per eM label is an intentional exception. Team UI convention in Proteus 1751b28b0. PPM, pixels per em, is the size at which a rasterizer renders a font: how many pixels one em occupies. TrueType hints, device corrections and bitmap strikes are specified per PPM. In explanatory prose expand it; in hinting fields the short form is usual. production glyph name shipping glyph name ชื่อรูปอักษรสำหรับโปรดักชัน proposed No attestation; โปรดักชัน is the loan Cadson Demak articles (cadsondemak.com) use for font production. A production glyph name is the name written into the exported font, chosen for compatibility with tools and the Adobe Glyph List, such as uni00C1 rather than Aacute. rendering drawing on screen การเรนเดอร์ proposed Adobe th and Thai developer documentation. Rendering is the conversion of an outline into pixels on a screen or a printer. The rasterizer of the operating system or of FontLab's preview reads the outline, applies the hints and paints the result. FontLab previews rendering at chosen pixel sizes so you can judge hints. Rasterization names the same step from the pixel side. required glyphs mandatory glyphs รูปอักษรที่จำเป็น proposed Derived from รูปอักษร; Apple renders Required Ligatures as ลิเกเจอร์ที่จำเป็น. Required glyphs are the ones the OpenType specification and common tools expect at the start of a font: .notdef, NULL or uni0000, CR or uni000D and space. FontLab can add them on export. right sidebearing ระยะข้างขวา proposed Derived from ระยะข้าง. Thai font makers on f0nt.com say ระยะหลัง (back), which assumes left-to-right text. Keep numeric controls compact: LSB/RSB (French AG/AD), UPM and PPM. Expanded terms belong in explanatory help; the full Family Dimensions Units Per eM label is an intentional exception. Team UI convention in Proteus 1751b28b0. The horizontal space between the right edge of a glyph outline and the end of its advance width. It contributes to spacing. sidebearing side space ระยะข้าง proposed No fixed Thai term; fallback 'side space' translated. Thai font makers say ระยะหน้า and ระยะหลัง, which depend on writing direction, and lump both under ช่องไฟ. A sidebearing is the space between a glyph's outline and the edge of its advance width: the left sidebearing before the shape, the right sidebearing after it. Together with the advance width it sets how the glyph spaces against every other glyph, which is the work that carries a text face further than kerning does. You edit sidebearings in the Metrics panel or with the Metrics tool, one glyph at a time or across a selection, and you check them in a word rather than in isolation. size ขนาด proposed Apple Font Book th and all Thai software. The size of an object or the chosen size of displayed text. Name a specific width or height when only one direction is intended. spacing ช่องไฟ proposed Cadson Demak articles (cadsondemak.com) gloss ช่องไฟ as Spacing and Thai font makers use it for fitting sidebearings; the SSRU typography textbook (Kwanjai Sukkon) has การเว้นช่องไฟ. Adobe uses the same word for kerning, which here is เคิร์นนิง. The adjustment of glyph advance widths and sidebearings to establish the space between letters. Kerning makes additional adjustments to particular pairs. standard stem reference stem width เส้นลำตัวมาตรฐาน proposed Derived from เส้นลำตัว (stem). Standard stems are the representative horizontal and vertical stem widths declared in a font for hinting. The rasterizer snaps stems near those widths to the same pixel count, so like stems stay alike at small sizes. stem link stem tie ลิงก์เส้นลำตัว proposed Derived from เส้นลำตัว and ลิงก์; fallback 'stem tie'. A stem link ties two edges of a stroke together as a stem, so hinting can hold their distance as the size changes. A vertical link governs a horizontal measurement and a horizontal link governs a vertical one. You add links in the glyph, either by hand or from an autohinting pass, and you keep them consistent with the standard stem widths declared in Font Info. Vextra reuses the term for the paired edges it detects in artwork that is not type. styling group name ชื่อกลุ่มสไตล์ proposed Derived: Apple Font Book uses สไตล์ for style and กลุ่ม for group. The abbreviations SGN, SLV and SLN stay in Latin script. The styling group name, SGN, ties together the styles an application reaches through its bold and italic buttons, and the styling link value and styling link name say which slot each style takes in that group. The mechanism is older than typographic family names and narrower: four slots, no more. You set these fields in TransType when a family has to behave correctly in applications that still drive style selection from those buttons. subsetting cutting down a font การสร้างชุดย่อย proposed No attestation of the process noun; ชุดย่อย is the Thai for a subset (Google th has ส่วนย่อย). Subsetting exports only part of a font, such as the glyphs a page uses or one codepage, to make a smaller file. The OS/2 embedding bits can forbid it. top sidebearing ระยะข้างบน proposed Derived from ระยะข้าง; ข้างบน is the plain Thai for the upper side. The space above the glyph outline within its vertical advance. This value participates in vertical text spacing rather than horizontal spacing. tracking uniform letter spacing ระยะห่างตัวอักษร proposed Adobe th calls tracking การจัดระยะห่างตัวอักษร and Cadson Demak articles (cadsondemak.com) speak of ระยะห่างระหว่างตัวอักษร. Microsoft's การติดตาม is the surveillance sense. Tracking changes the spacing across a run of text, rather than correcting particular pairs as kerning does. Layout applications apply it to text. TransType's Tracking filter changes spacing in the font data itself. That changes the font's starting metrics; a layout application can still apply additional tracking to text set in the resulting font. TrueType instruction pixel fitting instruction คำสั่ง TrueType proposed คำสั่ง is the standard Thai for an instruction in a program; format name kept in Latin script. A TrueType instruction is one step of the program a TrueType font runs to fit an outline to the pixel grid. Instructions are the TrueType form of hints. FontLab writes them from visual TrueType hints and can keep the ones a font already has. Say instruction for the code and hint for what the reader draws. typographic family name ชื่อตระกูลเชิงไทโปกราฟี proposed Apple Font Book th has ชื่อตระกูล for family name; ไทโปกราฟี is the loan Thai designers use for typography. TFN and TSN stay in Latin script. The typographic family name, TFN, is the name that groups every style of a family under one entry, and the typographic style name, TSN, is what distinguishes a style inside it. They sit beside the older four style family and style names that legacy applications read. You set them in TransType and in Font Info, and you keep them consistent across a family, because an app that reads these fields builds its font menu from them. update metrics อัปเดตเมตริก proposed Derived from เมตริก; อัปเดต is the standard Thai software verb. Recalculate glyph spacing values from their links or expressions. This command updates the advance widths and sidebearings that depend on those relationships. variable font ฟอนต์แปรผัน proposed Google th docs say แบบอักษรแบบแปรผัน; rebuilt on ฟอนต์, the profession's word. Cadson Demak articles (cadsondemak.com) keep Variable Font in English; Google's ฟอนต์ตัวแปร reads as a programming variable. A variable font contains data for design variation along one or more axes. Applications select axis values and calculate the corresponding outlines and other variable data. Named instances identify selected locations, but users are not limited to those locations when the application exposes axis controls. A variable font's supported range depends on its data; it need not contain every style in the family. variation location position in the variation range ตำแหน่งการแปรผัน proposed Google th docs use ตำแหน่ง for a location on an axis; compact form ตำแหน่ง. A variation location is a point in the design space, given as one value per axis. Masters and instances each have one, and the Variations panel slider shows the current one. vertical advance glyph box height ความสูงกรอบ proposed No attestation; fallback 'glyph box height' translated, parallel to ความกว้างกรอบ. The vertical advance is the distance a glyph advances in vertical text, the counterpart of advance width for East Asian layout. Stored in vmtx. vertical metrics เมตริกแนวตั้ง proposed Derived from เมตริก; แนวตั้ง is Apple th for vertical. The font-wide vertical values used for line layout, including ascender, descender and line gap. FontLab groups these as dimensions, distinct from glyph spacing metrics. visual kerning shape-measured spacing correction เคิร์นนิงเชิงภาพ proposed No attestation; derived from เคิร์นนิง. Adobe th calls its own optical kerning แบบออปติคัล. Visual kerning is kerning that FontLab proposes by measuring the shapes, so that a font gets a usable first pass without a person typing thousands of values. You run it over a selection, then review what it produced, because a measurement of two outlines does not know about the words a reader will meet. Treat the result as a draft: keep the pairs it got right, correct the ones it did not, and kern the difficult pairs by eye in real words. weight axis thickness axis แกนน้ำหนัก proposed Google th variable font docs (แกนน้ำหนัก). The weight axis, tag wght, varies stroke thickness from light to bold. In a variable font it is the most common axis; its master locations use the usWeightClass scale, such as 400 for Regular and 700 for Bold. weight class คลาสน้ำหนัก proposed Derived from น้ำหนัก and คลาส. The weight class is the OS/2 value from 100 to 900 that tells applications how heavy a style is, with 400 for Regular and 700 for Bold. Style linking and menus rely on it. width axis narrow-to-wide axis แกนความกว้าง proposed Google th variable font docs (แกนความกว้าง). The width axis, tag wdth, varies letter proportions from condensed to extended. It is distinct from advance width, which is the spacing of one glyph, and from the geometric width of a shape. Its scale is a percentage of normal width. width class คลาสความกว้าง proposed Derived from ความกว้าง and คลาส. The width class is the OS/2 value from 1, ultra condensed, to 9, ultra expanded, that tells applications how wide a style is. It is a classification, not the width axis value and not the advance width.

docs.title: OpenType
docs.text: English Fallback Thai Status Note Definition Adobe Glyph List Adobe Glyph List do-not-translate The Adobe Glyph List maps standard glyph names to Unicode codepoints, so that a glyph named aacute is understood as U plus 00E1 by any tool that follows it. You name glyphs by it wherever it covers the character, because tools and text engines can then infer the mapping without being told twice. Where it does not cover a glyph, you fall back to a consistent scheme of your own and assign codepoints explicitly. Write the name in full on first mention, then AGL. alternate glyph glyph variant รูปอักษรทางเลือก proposed Cadson Demak articles (cadsondemak.com) use อักขระทางเลือก for alternate characters (40 hits); derived from the chosen glyph noun รูปอักษร. Apple's รูปแบบอื่น ('other form') rejected as vague. An alternate glyph is another form of the same character, selected through an OpenType feature such as salt or a stylistic set. Its name usually carries a suffix, as in a.alt or g.ss01. cmap cmap do-not-translate The cmap table maps character codes to glyph indices. Its Unicode subtables provide the initial mapping used in text rendering; other subtables support particular encodings or variation sequences. FontLab generates these mappings from the project's encoding data. A glyph without its own Unicode assignment can still appear in typed text through substitution, such as a ligature or alternate selected by the shaping engine. code page legacy character table โค้ดเพจ proposed Microsoft Windows th glossary. A code page is a numbered legacy encoding, such as Windows 1250 for Central European languages, that maps one byte to one character. The OS/2 table lists the code pages a font supports, and FontLab derives that list from the glyphs present. Write two words. color font table ตารางฟอนต์สี proposed Derived: ตาราง for a font table, ฟอนต์สี for color font. The table tags stay in Latin script. Colour-font tables store data for colour glyph rendering. Formats include COLR with CPAL, SVG, sbix, and CBDT with CBLC. They differ in how they describe vector or bitmap content and in application support. Including several formats can extend coverage, but does not guarantee rendering in every application. Identify the exported formats and test the intended targets. contextual alternates context-dependent variants ทางเลือกตามบริบท proposed Adobe th has ตัวเลือกตามบริบท and Apple รูปแบบอื่นเชิงบริบท; rebuilt on the chosen noun ทางเลือก. Contextual alternates, the calt feature, cover substitutions an app makes because of what sits around a glyph rather than because a reader asked. In a script face the text engine replaces an entry stroke after a letter that already ends in one, and in a face with repeating shapes it replaces the second of a pair. You write the rules with context in feature code, and apps usually leave calt on by default, which makes it the feature most likely to surprise you when a rule is too broad. cursive attachment joined-script connection การเชื่อมต่อแบบตัวเขียน proposed No attestation; fallback 'joined-script connection' translated. Apple's การเชื่อมต่อแบบโค้ง mistakes cursive for curved. Cursive attachment joins glyphs by matching an exit anchor of one glyph to the entry anchor of the next, so connected scripts such as Arabic and Nastaliq flow. It is the curs feature, built from anchors. design languages ภาษาเป้าหมาย proposed No attestation; follows the reviewed German and Polish 'target languages'. Apple Font Book labels the same data ออกแบบมาสำหรับ. Design languages, the meta table dlng record, list the languages the typeface was designed for. Supported languages, slng, list every language it can set. Both are language tags, not feature tags. encoding การเข้ารหัส proposed Cadson Demak articles (cadsondemak.com) and general Thai software use การเข้ารหัส; FontForge th has รหัสอักขระ for a named encoding. An encoding maps character codes to glyphs. Unicode is the encoding modern fonts use; legacy encodings such as Mac Roman or a code page map one byte to one glyph. FontLab shows the font in a chosen encoding in the Font window and writes the cmap from it. Say encoding for the mapping and code page for a numbered legacy table. feature code layout rule code โค้ดฟีเจอร์ proposed Derived from ฟีเจอร์; Thai font makers on f0nt.com call it โค้ด OpenType. Feature code is the text syntax that describes OpenType features: classes, lookups, substitution and positioning rules, grouped into features by tag. It is usually called FEA, after the file extension. You edit it in the Features panel, compile it to check for errors, and keep it under the same review as the drawings, since a rule that fires on the wrong glyph is as visible as a wrong outline. FontLab compiles it into GSUB and GPOS at export. fractions เศษส่วน proposed Apple CoreText th. Fractions are numerical forms such as ½. In OpenType, the frac feature supports diagonal fraction composition through glyph substitution. A font may provide precomposed fraction glyphs, numerator and denominator forms, or both. The separate numr and dnom features provide numerator and denominator forms. Do not substitute the sups and subs feature names for these mechanisms or promise support for every input sequence without testing it. glyph index glyph number ดัชนีรูปอักษร proposed Apple Font Book th: Glyph Index and Name = ดัชนีและชื่อรูปอักษร. A glyph index is the number a glyph occupies in the font's own order, counting from zero. Text engines work in indices after the cmap has done its job, and binary tables reference glyphs by index rather than by name. You rarely set one by hand, but you meet it when you inspect a compiled font or debug a lookup that fires on the wrong glyph. The index depends on glyph order, so it changes when the order does. glyph name ชื่อรูปอักษร proposed Apple Font Book th (ชื่อรูปอักษร). A glyph name identifies a glyph in an editing project, feature code or a tool's data. Names such as a, a.sc and a.alt can distinguish related drawings. They are separate from Unicode assignments and glyph indices, and need not survive in every exported format. After renaming a glyph, check references in feature code, classes and scripts, including references the editor cannot update automatically. GPOS GPOS do-not-translate GPOS is the OpenType table that holds positioning: kerning, mark attachment, cursive attachment, and any rule that moves a glyph without replacing it. FontLab writes your kerning here, as pairs and as class based positioning, and builds the mark lookups from your anchors. You reach it through feature code rather than by editing the table. A font may also carry a legacy kern table; modern text engines read GPOS and many ignore the other. GSUB GSUB do-not-translate GSUB is the OpenType table containing glyph-substitution lookups. It supports operations such as replacing a glyph with an alternate, forming a ligature or selecting a form from its context. FontLab compiles feature code into these structures. To diagnose a missing substitution, check the glyphs, compiled rules, feature selection, language and shaping order in the target application. ligature joined letters อักษรควบ proposed Cadson Demak articles (cadsondemak.com) gloss Ligature as ตัวอักษรควบ or อักษรควบ. Apple's loan ลิเกเจอร์ and the SSRU typography textbook (Kwanjai Sukkon)'s ตัวแฝด are the alternatives. A ligature is a glyph used to represent a sequence of characters, such as fi. OpenType substitution can replace several glyphs with one ligature glyph. The liga and dlig features distinguish standard and discretionary ligatures. Shaping does not change the underlying text; whether a later document export preserves searchable text also depends on that export and its text mappings. localized forms language-specific variants รูปแบบเฉพาะภาษา proposed No attestation; fallback 'language-specific variants' translated with Apple's รูปแบบ for 'forms'. Localized forms are glyph variants selected for a text run's language. The OpenType locl feature can provide these substitutions, for example Bulgarian forms of Cyrillic letters. The shaping engine needs the relevant language information, which the application may obtain from a setting or other context. The substitution changes glyph selection, not the underlying characters or their codepoints. lookup procedure กระบวนงาน approved User/team procedure fallback. No sufficiently strong established OpenType-specific alternative verified in the reviewed primary sources. Keep the approved contextual Rules panel title. Preserve literal FEA lookup/lookupflag keywords, identifiers and OpenType structure names. Ordinary search senses are separate. A lookup groups substitution or positioning rules of one type in GSUB or GPOS. Features reference lookups, and several features can share one. The shaping engine selects features and may process them in script-specific stages; within a stage, LookupList order matters. Source-code order alone does not describe the complete shaping sequence. Inspect the compiled tables and the target engine when diagnosing ordering problems. mark glyph combining mark glyph รูปอักษรเครื่องหมาย proposed Derived from รูปอักษร and เครื่องหมาย; for Thai these are the สระ above and below and the วรรณยุกต์. A mark glyph is an accent or other combining mark that attaches to a base glyph through anchors. The GDEF table classes it as a mark so shaping engines position it rather than advancing past it. nonspacing mark zero-width combining mark เครื่องหมายไม่กินที่ proposed Derived from เครื่องหมาย and ไม่กินที่ (nonspacing). FontForge th renders the Unicode 'spacing' as ใช้เนื้อที่. A nonspacing mark is the Unicode general category Mn: a combining mark with zero advance, such as a combining acute. It differs from FontLab's nonspacing element, which is a property of an element inside a glyph. oldstyle figures lowercase-style figures ตัวเลขแบบโอลด์สไตล์ proposed Cadson Demak articles (cadsondemak.com) write ตัวเลขแบบโอลด์สไตล์ (Oldstyle figures). Apple's ตัวเลขลักษณะเก่า is a literal calque. Oldstyle figures are numerals with varying heights, often including forms with ascenders and descenders. The OpenType onum feature selects them when provided by the font. Figure height and figure width are separate choices: oldstyle figures can be proportional or tabular. Use tabular widths when numerals must align in columns, whether their forms are oldstyle or lining. OpenType class layout glyph group คลาส OpenType proposed คลาส as in Apple Font Book and Thai FontLab tutorials; format name kept in Latin script. An OpenType class is a named group of glyphs that feature code can address at once, written with an at sign before the name. One rule over two classes replaces a page of single rules, and one edit to a class reaches every rule that cites it. You define classes in the Classes panel or in feature code, and you keep their order stable, because a substitution between two classes pairs them by position. Kerning classes are a separate mechanism with the same idea. OpenType feature layout feature ฟีเจอร์ OpenType proposed Adobe th and Cadson Demak articles (cadsondemak.com) say ฟีเจอร์ for OpenType features. An OpenType feature identifies typographic behaviour through a four-character tag, such as liga, smcp or ss01. Feature records reference substitution or positioning lookups. In FontLab, you can write feature code and compile it into the font. Whether and when a feature is applied depends on the shaping engine, script, language and application settings; not every feature is a user-controlled switch. OS/2 table ตาราง OS/2 proposed Tag kept in Latin script, noun translated. The OS/2 table carries the font's metadata for applications: vertical metrics, weight and width classes, embedding permissions, the panose values, and the codepage and Unicode range bits that say what the font covers. You fill it from Font Info rather than by hand, and you check it before release, because a wrong weight class puts a font in the wrong slot in a menu and wrong vertical metrics change line spacing in every browser. Write it with the slash: OS/2. Private Use Area Private Use Area do-not-translate A private-use area is one of three Unicode blocks whose codepoints can receive meanings by private agreement. Different fonts or systems may assign different meanings to the same private-use codepoint. Use a documented agreement when encoding custom symbols there. An alternate glyph reached through a feature does not require its own private-use assignment. single substitution การแทนที่เดี่ยว proposed Apple CoreText th uses แทนที่ for substitution; เดี่ยว for single. A single substitution replaces one glyph with one other glyph, the simplest GSUB lookup type. Small caps, stylistic alternates and localized forms are mostly built from it. small caps small capitals ตัวพิมพ์ใหญ่ขนาดเล็ก proposed Apple CoreText th (Small Caps). Small caps are capital shapes drawn at roughly lowercase height, with their own weight and width rather than scaled capitals. Apps apply the smcp feature to put them in place of lowercase letters, and c2sc to put them in place of capitals, so a run set in both features becomes uniform. You draw them as separate glyphs, usually with a dot sc suffix, and write both features. Scaled capitals look thin beside real text, which is the reason to draw them rather than let an app fake them. stylistic set ชุดลักษณะ proposed Apple CoreText th (Stylistic Set %d = ชุดลักษณะ %d). Microsoft Word's ชุดอักษรดัดแปลง is longer. A stylistic set is a numbered group of alternate glyphs a reader can switch on, from ss01 through ss20. Each set holds alternates that belong together: a single storey a with a matching g, a set of flat topped figures. You name each set in the font so an app can show a readable label instead of a number, and you keep one idea per set. A set that mixes unrelated alternates gives a reader nothing they can decide about. tabular figures equal-width figures ตัวเลขแบบตาราง proposed Apple CoreText th (Tabular numbers). Tabular figures all carry the same advance width, so columns of numbers line up whatever digits they contain. Apps apply the tnum feature to put them in place of proportional figures. You draw them as a separate set and give every one the same width, centring the narrow digits inside it. They matter in any table, price list, or running total, and they look loose in prose, which is why a font offers both sets rather than choosing for the reader. Unicode codepoint character code จุดรหัส Unicode proposed จุดรหัส is the Thai rendering of code point in Thai-language Unicode references; the corpus has รหัสอักขระ, which is the encoding sense in FontForge th. A Unicode codepoint is an integer from U+0000 to U+10FFFF. Not every codepoint has an assigned character. Write it with U+ and at least four hexadecimal digits, as in U+0041 for A. In a font editor, a glyph's Unicode assignment connects it to an encoded character; the exported cmap records the relevant mapping. variation selector variant picker character ตัวเลือกรูปแปร proposed No attestation; fallback 'variant picker character' translated with รูปแปร, the Thai linguistic term for a variant form. A variation selector is a Unicode character that follows a base character to request a specific glyph form. The pair is a variation sequence, mapped in the cmap format 14 subtable; a default mapping points at the base glyph. writing system ระบบการเขียน proposed Cadson Demak articles (cadsondemak.com) (22 hits) and Microsoft th. Apple Font Book's สคริปต์ is kept for the OpenType script tag only. A writing system is the set of characters and rules a language writes with, such as Latin, Cyrillic or Arabic. OpenType calls it a script and identifies it by a four letter tag. Say writing system in prose and script tag for the identifier, so the reader does not confuse it with a Python script.

docs.title: File formats
docs.text: English Fallback Thai Status Note Definition AI file AI file do-not-translate An AI file is an Adobe Illustrator document, and it is the container the Vexy Illustrator plug-ins work inside. It holds paths, strokes, fills, appearances, and the live effects that a plug-in adds. You do not export an AI file from the plug-ins; you work in one. Write it as an AI file or an Illustrator document, never as an ai, and name Adobe Illustrator in full on first mention in the same document. AIP AIP do-not-translate An AIP file is an Adobe Illustrator plug-in binary, and it is how Vexy Linestra and Vexy Vextra reach Illustrator. The filenames close up the product name, VexyLinestra.aip and VexyVextra.aip, while prose keeps the space. You copy the file into the Illustrator plug-ins folder, whose name the operating system may show translated, and restart Illustrator so it loads. Name the file exactly as it ships, since a renamed plug-in does not load. FLREQ FLREQ do-not-translate An FLREQ file is a licence request the application writes when a machine cannot reach the licensing service, and an FLLIC file is the response that activates it. You send the request from the machine that needs the licence, receive the response, and open it there. The pair exists for machines that stay offline, so name both files in a procedure that uses either, and say which machine each step happens on. Fog.net Fog.net do-not-translate Fog.net is Fontographer's project data format, and fognet is the Python module that reads and writes it from a script. A project file carries the extension .fog. You meet the format when you script against a project or move one between machines, rather than in ordinary editing, where the dashboard handles saving. The module name is lowercase, as Python module names are, and it goes in code font wherever it appears in prose. Glyphs file Glyphs file do-not-translate A Glyphs file is the source format of the Glyphs editor, and FontLab reads and writes it so that a project can move between the two. It holds masters, glyphs, metrics, and features in one text file. You use it when a collaborator works in the other editor, and you check the result after the trip, because two editors model masters and components in ways that do not correspond exactly. Write it as a Glyphs file, not as a glyphs. Lines file Lines file do-not-translate A Lines file is the native document of Vexy Lines, holding the source image, the fills applied to it, and the settings that produced the result. You save to it while you work and export vector artwork when you are finished, because the export keeps the result and not the recipe. Write it as a Lines file with a capital L when you name the format, and as the extension in lowercase with a dot when you mean the file suffix. OTF OTF do-not-translate OTF is the usual filename extension for an OpenType font with PostScript outlines. These use cubic curves stored in CFF or CFF2 data. State the outline flavour when it matters: OpenType fonts with TrueType outlines also support OpenType layout features. The .otf extension alone does not establish which features, colour formats or variation capabilities a font contains. SVG SVG do-not-translate SVG is the vector graphics format, and it names two different things in this documentation: a graphic file that a drawing tool exports, and the SVG table inside a colour font. Say which you mean. You export SVG artwork from the Vexy products, and you meet the SVG table when you build a colour font in FontLab. A sentence that says SVG support without saying which one leaves a reader to guess. TTC TTC do-not-translate TTC is the usual filename extension for a TrueType font collection: several fonts stored in one file. Collection members can share tables, reducing duplication where their data is identical. A collection is a packaging format, not an interpolation model. Distinguish its individual fonts from named instances within a variable font. TTF TTF do-not-translate TTF is the usual filename extension for a font with TrueType outlines, which use quadratic curves. An OpenType TTF can contain layout features and variation data. Exporting cubic source outlines to this flavour requires curve conversion, which can change the point structure and approximate the original geometry. Check the exported outlines at the intended sizes. Type 1 Type 1 do-not-translate Type 1 is an older PostScript outline-font format. It remains relevant when opening archived fonts or explaining conversion workflows. Support depends on the application and version, so identify the target when discussing compatibility. Converting a Type 1 font to OpenType does not automatically supply missing Unicode mappings or new layout features. UFO UFO do-not-translate UFO, Unified Font Object, is an open source-font format. UFO 3 stores glyph layers, font information, kerning, groups and optional feature code in a directory package or ZIP archive. It also allows images and application-specific data. Interchange depends on what both applications support; a UFO export does not by itself guarantee that every editor-specific property survives. VFB VFB do-not-translate VFB is the native source format of FontLab Studio 5. FontLab 8 can open and export it, but the format cannot represent every feature of a FontLab 8 project. Use VFC or VFJ for ongoing work in FontLab 8. Name VFB when explaining migration or an exchange workflow that requires the older format, and check the exported result for unsupported data. VFC VFC do-not-translate VFC is FontLab's native binary format, and the one you work in. It holds everything the editor knows: masters, elements, references, anchors, kerning, features, and the project settings that no font format carries. You save to it while you design and export to OTF or TTF when you ship. Write the format in capitals when you name it and in lowercase with a dot when you mean the extension. Its sibling VFJ stores the same content as text. VFJ VFJ do-not-translate VFJ is FontLab's JSON source format. It provides a text representation of a FontLab project for workflows that need readable or scriptable data. Use it as a source format, not an installable font. When exchanging files between FontLab versions or external tools, check that the receiving tool supports the data the project uses. WOFF2 WOFF2 do-not-translate WOFF2 is a compressed font format for web delivery. Its encoding uses font-specific transformations and Brotli compression. Export it for web use and test the resulting font in the target browsers. The size saving depends on the source font and its contents; do not promise a fixed reduction or infer available features from the extension.

docs.title: Interface
docs.text: English Fallback Thai Status Note Definition action การดำเนินการ proposed Current Microsoft and Apple th wording for an invokable action; the corpus pick การกระทำ reads as 'deed' and is the older Office rendering. An action is an operation you can invoke in the application. An action label names the operation; help explains its effect. add เพิ่ม proposed Apple, FontForge and Microsoft th all use เพิ่ม. Add inserts another item into the current collection or selection. Name the item when the surrounding control does not make it clear. alternate ทางเลือก proposed Short form of the foundry term อักขระทางเลือก (Cadson Demak articles (cadsondemak.com)). Apple CoreText รูปแบบอื่น rejected; ตัวเลือก is kept for 'option'. An alternate is a different glyph form for the same character or purpose. The context determines how you select or substitute that form. anchor cloud attachment point cloud เมฆจุดยึด proposed No attestation; cloud (เมฆ) plus the chosen anchor noun จุดยึด. Compact form เมฆ where the English says only 'cloud'. The anchor cloud previews the marks that attach to an anchor by showing them faintly around the glyph in the Glyph window. It checks mark positioning without leaving the base glyph. auto layer recipe-built layer เลเยอร์อัตโนมัติ proposed Derived from เลเยอร์ plus อัตโนมัติ; no attestation of the FontLab feature name. An auto layer builds a glyph from a recipe, such as A plus acute, and rebuilds it when the parts change. Turn auto off to edit the glyph by hand. autohint ฮินต์อัตโนมัติ proposed Command form derived from the chosen noun ฮินต์ (GIMP th การฮินต์). Autohint is the command to generate hints automatically. Use autohinting when naming the process rather than the command. Brush แปรง proposed Adobe th (วาดและระบายด้วยแปรง) and Apple use แปรง; the real tool's name. The Brush tool draws a stroke freehand, and what the stroke becomes differs by product. In FontLab and Fontographer the Brush keeps the path you drew as a centreline and generates the thick outline from it, so the drawing stays editable until you expand it into ordinary contours. In Vexy Lines the Brush paints masks by hand, and a mask decides where a layer's fills can draw rather than being artwork itself. Name the application in any sentence where a reader could take one tool for the other. collapse ยุบ proposed Apple and Microsoft th use ยุบ for collapse. Here it aligns nodes to one point without merging them; check the label in context. Collapse aligns the selected nodes to one point. In the Contour tool it aligns both coordinates; in the Metrics tool only the horizontal one. It moves nodes; it does not merge them. color flag color mark ธงสี proposed No attestation; fallback 'color mark' rendered with the literal flag (ธง), which Thai mail and task apps use for flagging. A color flag is a color you assign to a glyph cell, a kerning pair or a class to mark it for later. Flags are annotations for the designer and are not exported. corner angles องศาของมุม proposed No attestation. Thai มุม means both corner and angle, so the angle is expressed as องศา to avoid มุมของมุม. The angles at contour vertices. These geometric measurements describe how adjacent segments meet at a corner and can be displayed on the canvas. cousins related glyphs alongside ลูกพี่ลูกน้อง proposed House voice: the plain Thai word for cousins as a family group; no professional term exists for this FontLab feature. Cousins are related glyphs or other masters that FontLab shows faintly around the current glyph in the Glyph window, so you can compare shapes and spacing while you edit. The name is FontLab's, rendered in each language's house voice. crop ครอบตัด proposed Apple, Microsoft and Adobe th. Crop trims an image or drawing to a chosen area. The command label names the operation; its context identifies the object being cropped. cubic กำลังสาม proposed Thai mathematics uses กำลังสาม for cubic (สมการกำลังสาม). GIMP's เชิงลูกบาศก์ suggests a physical cube. A cubic Bézier segment is a curve defined by two endpoints and two control points. Cubic describes the degree of the curve, not its physical dimensions. current ปัจจุบัน proposed Apple and Microsoft th. Current identifies the item or state active at the time of an operation. Name the item, such as the current layer, when the context is ambiguous. cusp จุดแหลม proposed No attestation; a sharp point, built on แหลม (sharp) so the node family stays consistent. A cusp is a sharp point where a curve changes direction abruptly. Keep it distinct from a smooth join. decompose break into contours แตกคอมโพเนนต์ proposed Thai designers say แตก for breaking live objects into outlines (แตกฟอนต์); applied to the chosen noun คอมโพเนนต์. No attestation of the FontLab command. Decompose replaces components with copies of their contours, so the glyph no longer follows its source glyphs. Use it before edits that a component cannot carry, or before export to a format without composites. default ค่าเริ่มต้น proposed Apple, Microsoft and Google th. A default is the value or choice used when no explicit alternative has been selected. It need not be the currently selected value. demo mode โหมดเดโม proposed โหมด plus the common Thai loan เดโม; Microsoft's สาธิต sounds like a presentation rather than an unlicensed run. Demo mode is how FontLab runs without a license: everything works except saving, exporting and printing. dialog กล่องโต้ตอบ proposed Microsoft Windows th glossary and Inkscape th. A dialog presents information, settings or a question for a particular interaction. A modal dialog restricts interaction with its parent until it is dismissed; a modeless dialog does not. Use the application's established name and reproduce its button labels exactly. If a procedure opens a dialog, explain the relevant choices and how to apply or cancel them. Dream Up generate shapes เสก proposed House voice: เสก is the everyday Thai verb for conjuring something up by magic, matching Polish wyczaruj. The corpus fallback สร้างรูปร่าง is a flat description. Dream Up is a Fontographer command for generating glyph shapes. Dream Up Font generates a whole font; Mixfont blends existing fonts. Keep these commands distinct and show any confirmed cost before the reader runs an operation. Generated shapes may need further editing. echo text repeated text สะท้อนข้อความ proposed No attestation; echo rendered as สะท้อน (to echo back), verb first like the reviewed languages. Echo text makes a preview repeat the text of the current window, so the Preview panel or the TrueType hinting preview shows the same string you are editing. Eraser ยางลบ proposed Apple and Microsoft th; the real tool's name. The Eraser removes or simplifies points on a contour. In FontLab, its modes remove nodes and handles, select points for removal, or simplify a path. In Vexy Vextra, normal Eraser removes covered points; Soft Eraser removes a node only when a replacement curve is close enough to the original. That does not guarantee an identical outline. In Fontographer, Eraser shares a grouped toolbar button with Trowel. Name the application and mode when describing an operation. expand filter bake filter into contours แปลงฟิลเตอร์เป็นคอนทัวร์ proposed No attestation; fallback 'bake filter into contours' translated on the pattern 'convert X to contours', as the German does. Expand filter bakes a live element filter, such as Smart Corners, Skin or a boolean Fusion, into plain contours. The filter parameters are no longer editable afterwards. expand stroke bake stroke into contours แปลงเส้นขีดเป็นคอนทัวร์ proposed No attestation; same pattern as expand filter, with เส้นขีด for stroke. Expand stroke converts a stroked centerline, or a brush applied to a contour, into plain filled contours. The live stroke or brush is gone afterwards and the result can be edited node by node. expand transformation bake transformation into contours ปรับใช้การแปลงรูป proposed No attestation; fallback translated as 'apply the transformation', the wording 3D and vector tools use for writing a live transform into coordinates. Expand transformation writes an element's live transformation, such as scaling or rotation, into the node coordinates. The element then has an identity transformation and its contours carry the geometry directly. feature ฟีเจอร์ proposed Cadson Demak articles (cadsondemak.com) and Adobe th use ฟีเจอร์ for OpenType features. Apple's คุณสมบัติ also means 'property'. A feature in OpenType editing identifies typographic behavior implemented by substitution or positioning lookups. Feature tags are literal identifiers and remain unchanged in translation. Fills การเติม proposed Adobe th says สีเติม for a colour fill and uses เติม as the verb; the neutral noun การเติม is used because FontLab and Vexy fills are not colours. In FontLab, the Fill tool sets enclosed regions as filled or unfilled by changing contour direction or applying a live Fill filter. In Vexy Lines, Linestra and Playlines, a fill mode is a method for generating artwork from an image, such as Halftone or Stipple. Name the application and distinguish the tool, the filled region and the generative mode. FontAudit ฟอนต์ออดิท proposed User requires phonetic transliteration, explicitly including Chinese. Russian and Ukrainian spellings were recovered from team QPH; other spellings are proposals. Retain the FontAudit identity; do not translate as a generic audit command. Preserve FontAudit in code and identifiers. FontAudit is the FontLab panel that inspects outlines and reports the problems a proof will show later: unclosed contours, wrong winding directions, missing extreme nodes, near vertical segments, and the like. You run it over a glyph or a selection, read the findings, and fix what matters for the design rather than clearing every warning. In English write the FontAudit panel on first mention. Localized UI may transliterate the name into its writing system; keep the name distinct from a generic audit command. Preserve FontAudit in code and identifiers. FontLab account บัญชี FontLab proposed Translate the common noun account and inflect it in complete sentences; preserve the FontLab brand. German, Spanish and French wording is already used in current FontLab UI. Other language forms are proposals. Do not duplicate account when the surrounding sentence already translates it. A FontLab account is the identity used to sign in to FontLab services and manage licences. Keep the capital L in FontLab and lowercase account in English. Translate the common noun account while preserving the FontLab name. Distinguish the account from a licence, subscription or payment when more than one appears in the same explanation. Fusion Welder ช่างเชื่อม proposed User decision 2026-10-04: translate the fallback Welder, the named live boolean group filter. Polish Spawacz is explicit; other renderings are proposals. Preserve Fusion in code identifiers. Fusion is FontLab's live boolean filter on an element group: add, subtract, intersect or exclude the overlapping contours while the parts stay editable. Intersect keeps only the overlap; expand the filter to bake the result. Genius node self-balancing node โหนดอัจฉริยะ proposed อัจฉริยะ is the literal Thai for genius and is free for this name because Smart is rendered ฉลาด. Keeping Genius in Latin script, as German and Polish do, is the alternative. A Genius node keeps its curves smooth and balanced automatically when neighbours move; FontLab adjusts its handles for you. A Follower node follows key nodes under Power Nudge. Both are FontLab names, rendered in each language's house voice. grid กริด proposed Adobe th (กริด) and Thai design usage; เส้นตาราง is the spreadsheet sense. A grid is a set of regularly spaced reference lines or points used to position drawing objects. Keep it distinct from a mesh used for deformation. Groups กลุ่ม proposed Apple, Microsoft and Adobe th. A group collects several things and treats them as one, and the things differ by product. In FontLab the word most often means a kerning group, the set of glyphs that kern alike, which the documentation also calls a kerning class. In Vexy Vextra, following Illustrator, a group is selected artwork bound into one object. In Vexy Lines a group bundles layers and carries its own source image, working like a folder. TransType adds a styling group that ties a family's styles into a menu. Say which you mean. guide ไกด์ proposed GIMP and Inkscape th; Thai FontLab users on f0nt.com say ไกด์ and เส้นไกด์. A guide is a reference line used to position or align drawing objects. Its name describes its role rather than a visible stroke in the exported glyph. kerning mode โหมดเคิร์นนิง proposed Derived from โหมด and เคิร์นนิง. The editing mode for adjusting spacing between pairs of glyphs. It changes pair adjustments rather than the individual glyph sidebearings. Knife มีด proposed Apple th; the real tool's name. The Knife tool works along a line you drag across a shape, and what it leaves behind differs by product and by sub-tool. In FontLab it adds nodes where the line crosses a contour, breaks a closed contour into open paths, or slices one contour into two closed shapes, depending on which of its three sub-tools is active. In Fontographer it cuts through contours along the drawn path. In Vexy Lines it inserts points and splits curves. Say which app, which mode, and what the cut leaves. layer เลเยอร์ proposed Adobe, Microsoft and GIMP th all use เลเยอร์. A layer holds one drawing or part of a document. In FontLab, the context identifies the glyph layer; name the application when another product uses a different layer model. Layers เลเยอร์ proposed Same noun as layer; Thai has no plural form. Layers hold the separate drawings a glyph or a document carries at once. In FontLab a glyph layer holds one master, a mask, or a background, and you manage them in the Layers and Masters panel, where switching layers switches which drawing you edit. In Vexy Lines a layer is a transparent sheet holding one or more fills, and it is the basic unit of a document, since artwork needs at least one. The two meanings sit close enough to be mistaken, so a sentence about layers names the application. mark เครื่องหมาย proposed Microsoft and FontForge th (เครื่องหมายกำกับเสียง) use เครื่องหมาย; Thai font makers also say มาร์ก for the OpenType mark system. A mark in glyph positioning is a diacritical glyph positioned in relation to another glyph. A color mark or selection mark is a different interface meaning. Masks มาสก์ proposed Adobe th (มาสก์เลเยอร์) and Thai designers; Blender's หน้ากาก is the face mask. A mask holds a second drawing, and what it does with that drawing differs by product. In FontLab a mask is a glyph layer carrying a previous version or a reference shape, so you can compare the live outline against it and copy between them; it hides nothing. In Vexy Lines a mask is a vector stencil that decides where a layer's fills can draw, letting the fill through its transparent areas and holding it back elsewhere. Name the application, and in FontLab prefer the full phrase mask layer. match จับคู่ proposed Blender and Apple th; the plain verb for pairing things up, and it ties in with Matchmaker (แม่สื่อ). Match makes selected properties correspond. The object and context determine whether this means synchronizing edits, matching geometry or comparing values. matching ตรงกัน proposed Apple th uses ตรงกัน for items that match; kept apart from the verb จับคู่. Matching describes objects or properties that correspond. Name the matched property when the interface context does not identify it. Matchmaker master matcher แม่สื่อ proposed House voice: the traditional Thai village matchmaker, as Polish swat. The fallback 'master matcher' would give the flat ตัวจับคู่มาสเตอร์. Matchmaker is a FontLab tool for examining and correcting correspondence between glyph masters. It helps align contour order and start points for interpolation. Matching structures does not guarantee that intermediate outlines look right. Inspect the resulting interpolation; changing contour order or a start point can change correspondence without changing the outline's geometry at the master location. measurement line เส้นวัด proposed No attestation; derived from วัด (to measure). Kept apart from เมตริก. A line that shows a measured distance in the drawing. Distinguish this geometric measurement from a metrics line used to calculate sidebearings. measurements การวัด proposed No attestation for the FontLab sense; plain Thai for measurements, distinct from เมตริก (spacing) and มิติ (font dimensions). Values displayed on the canvas to describe geometry, such as coordinates, lengths, angles, tensions and counters. Showing measurements does not modify glyph spacing or font dimensions. Measurements panel แผงการวัด proposed Derived from แผง and การวัด; short enough for the panel title. The Measurements panel lists measured dimensions of the current font: stems, serifs, overshoots, contrast and heights, separately for capitals and lowercase. Its labels are compact; translations must not exceed the English length. merge ผสาน proposed Apple and Microsoft th. Merge combines items into a result. Name the items and explain what is retained when that distinction matters to the operation. mesh เมช proposed Blender and Inkscape th; kept apart from กริด (grid). A mesh is a network of connected points or cells used to describe or deform geometry. It is distinct from a drawing grid used for alignment. metrics mode โหมดเมตริก proposed Derived from โหมด and เมตริก. The editing mode for adjusting glyph advance widths and sidebearings. It changes the spacing of glyphs rather than the vertical dimensions of the font or the visibility of measurements. metrics table ตารางเมตริก proposed Derived from ตาราง and เมตริก. The table of glyph spacing values, including advance widths and sidebearings. It lets the user inspect or edit spacing values together. metrics tool เครื่องมือเมตริก proposed Derived from เครื่องมือ and เมตริก. The tool that edits glyph advance widths and sidebearings. Use it to adjust glyph spacing; canvas measurement overlays display values without changing those spacing values. monospaced ความกว้างเท่ากัน proposed Apple Font Book th (แบบความกว้างเท่ากัน); Cadson Demak articles (cadsondemak.com) describe monospaced type the same way. Monospaced describes text or a typeface whose ordinary spacing glyphs have equal advance widths. Marks and special glyphs can have different spacing behavior. multi-line หลายบรรทัด proposed Plain Thai; บรรทัด is the word for a line of text. Multi-line describes text or a control that contains more than one line. It does not imply more than one paragraph. nonspacing zero-width ไม่กินที่ proposed No attestation; fallback 'zero-width' rendered with the everyday Thai idiom for taking up no room. ไม่มีความกว้าง is the literal alternative. A nonspacing element or component is excluded from metrics: it stays visible and is exported, but FontLab ignores it when it computes the advance width and sidebearings. Detect nonspacing marks accents and other marks in composites automatically. Nudge push move เขยิบ proposed Microsoft Office th uses เขยิบ for Nudge; the everyday verb for shifting something a little. Nudge moves the selected nodes and adjusts the nearby handles so the curve keeps its shape. Power Nudge extends the move to more of the contour. Both are FontLab names. Oblique Oblique proposed A FontLab operation with a fixed meaning, kept in Latin script as the reviewed languages do. Apple's เฉียง names the style, not this command. Oblique is FontLab's action that slants a layer and applies a fixed set of optical corrections, so the result is closer to a designed oblique than a plain skew. Keep the name in every language; a plain slant is something else. panel แผง proposed Apple and Adobe th. A panel groups related controls or information within an application's interface. It may be docked or floating, depending on the application. Use its displayed name followed by panel in lowercase, as in the Kerning panel. Distinguish panels, windows, dialogs and panes by their role and established product terminology, not solely by whether they float, dock or contain tabs. Pencil ดินสอ proposed Apple and Microsoft th; the real tool's name. The Pencil tool draws freehand, and what it draws on differs by product. In FontLab it converts a freehand gesture into curves and line segments without asking you to think about node types. In Fontographer it is one of three outline drawing tools, beside Pen and Rapid. In Vexy Lines it creates and edits Handmade fills as vector lines. In Vexy Vextra it is the Correcting Pencil, which redraws part of an existing path as readily as it starts a new one. Power Brush power calligraphic brush แปรงพาวเวอร์ proposed House voice: พาวเวอร์ is the Thai loan of cartoons and gadgets (พาวเวอร์เรนเจอร์, พาวเวอร์แบงก์), not an industrial rating. Placed after the noun as Thai does. A Power Brush is a brush whose width can vary along the contour through thickness points. It stays live until you expand it. The name is FontLab's, rendered in each language's house voice. Power Guide power guideline ไกด์พาวเวอร์ proposed Same Power pattern on the chosen noun ไกด์. A Power Guide is a guide that nodes can link to, so moving the guide moves the linked nodes with it. FontLab uses it to keep a stem or a height consistent across a glyph. Each language renders the name with the same playful power. Power Nudge power push move เขยิบพาวเวอร์ proposed Same Power pattern on เขยิบ (nudge). Power Nudge distributes a move through a larger part of a contour by adjusting other nodes as well as the selected ones. FontLab and Vextra provide this editing mode. It differs from Nudge, which adjusts nearby handles. Power Nudge changes the geometry; inspect the result rather than promising an exactly preserved outline or a finished curve. Power Stroke power stroke outline เส้นขีดพาวเวอร์ proposed Same Power pattern on เส้นขีด (stroke). A Power Stroke is a stroke whose thickness varies along the path, controlled by thickness points you place with the Thickness tool. The related Power Brush does the same for a brush. Both are FontLab names, rendered in each language's house voice. project โปรเจกต์ approved Team agreement recovered from Proteus QPH on 2026-10-04. Project names the editable document; do not replace it with package. A FontLab project is the editable font document, including the active document in save/close prompts and the document saved to a VFJ/VFC file or project folder or connected to GitHub. Use the project term consistently in this UI. Do not call it a package. Python packages, UFO Packages, Glyphs Packages, and web-font distribution packages are different concepts and retain their format/software terminology. Internal package identifiers and file extensions are not translated. property bar แถบคุณสมบัติ proposed Microsoft th uses แถบ for a bar and คุณสมบัติ for properties. The property bar is FontLab's context-sensitive strip of controls for the current tool or selection. Name the required selection or tool before referring to a control that appears only in that context. Use property bar for this product element; do not invent a universal rule that all toolbars have fixed contents. quick measurement การวัดด่วน proposed Derived from การวัด; ด่วน is the Thai software word for 'quick' (Adobe มาสก์ด่วน). The function that displays measurements near the pointer while editing outlines. It reports geometry on the canvas without changing the glyph spacing values. redo ทำกลับมาใหม่ proposed Attested for Redo in Thai general software (corpus, 5 sources). The commoner ทำซ้ำ is needed here for Repeat, and ทำอีกครั้ง reads as 'do again'. Redo reapplies an operation that was undone. Repeat invokes an operation again and is a separate command. reference การอ้างอิง proposed Microsoft th and FontForge th (Bad Reference = การอ้างอิงไม่ถูกต้อง). A reference points to another object rather than being an independent copy of it. Name the referenced object when the context does not identify it. Remove Overlap merge overlapping contours ลบส่วนซ้อนทับ proposed No attestation of the command; Apple th uses ซ้อนทับ for overlap. Remove Overlap combines overlapping filled contour regions and removes their internal boundaries. It changes contour structure, so keep an editable source when the construction matters. Variable fonts can contain overlaps; removing them independently from masters can break point correspondence and interpolation. Apply the command or export option for the intended format and workflow, rather than treating it as mandatory for every font. repeat ทำซ้ำ proposed Microsoft Office th uses ทำซ้ำ for Repeat; kept apart from Redo (ทำกลับมาใหม่). Repeat invokes an operation again. Keep it distinct from Redo, which restores an operation after Undo. reverse contour flip drawing direction กลับทิศคอนทัวร์ proposed No attestation; fallback 'flip drawing direction' translated on the chosen noun คอนทัวร์. Reverse contour flips the winding direction of a contour. PostScript and TrueType outlines use opposite conventions, and a contour that runs the wrong way fills or unfills the wrong region. Scissors กรรไกร proposed Apple and Microsoft th; the real tool's name. The Scissors tool works on the joins in a path, and what it does with them differs by product. In FontLab it disconnects nodes into overlapping contours, creates overlaps, adds simple ink traps, and builds looped corners, with a toolbox of sub-tools under the Q shortcut. In Fontographer it breaks contours at selected points or segments, the targeted counterpart to Knife. In Vexy Vextra it extends and rebuilds path parts, building loop corners and joining open ends. Servant node Follower node โหนดผู้ตาม proposed Read as Follower node: ผู้ตาม is the plain Thai for a follower behind a leader (ผู้นำ). Compact label ผู้ตาม. For localization, read the legacy English source label Servant node as Follower node: a follower physically following a leader. This node follows the movement of neighboring key nodes when you move them with Power Nudge, so a whole feature moves together. Translate the motion-following role; the servant and social fan/supporter metaphors are obsolete. The English term and servant-node identifier remain compatibility lookup keys. Sigma Sigma do-not-translate Sigma is the Fontographer tool for variable font interpolation paths, sitting in the toolbar beside Transform and Meter. You use it to work with how a design moves through its variation space rather than to edit a single outline. The name is a single capitalized word and it does not take the word tool inside its name: write the Sigma tool. It is a Fontographer term with no counterpart in the other products. Sketchboard scratch canvas กระดานสเก็ตช์ proposed House voice: a sketching board, with the everyday Thai loan สเก็ตช์. No professional term exists. The Sketchboard is FontLab's unlimited canvas, a working surface where you can place glyphs, drawings, and reference images side by side outside the fixed frame of a glyph window. You use it to compare shapes, to sketch before committing, and to lay out material that has no single glyph to live in. The name is one word, capital S, and it is a FontLab term: no other product in the family has the surface or the word. Skin wrapping outline เปลือก proposed House voice: the peel or rind that wraps a fruit, as Polish skórka. The loan สกิน means a game or app theme and Photoshop's ผิวหนัง is human skin. Skin is a FontLab live filter that wraps a contour with a stroke of variable thickness, or cuts it into dashes. Expand the filter to get plain contours. Each language renders the name in the house voice. smart clever ฉลาด proposed The plain Thai word for clever, placed after the noun. อัจฉริยะ is the AI and smart-device word; หัวไว and หัวใส collide with หัว, the loop of a Thai letter; เจ้าเล่ห์ reads as deceitful; Adobe's loan สมาร์ท was also rejected. Smart prefixes FontLab features that decide details for you: Smart Corner, Smart Filter, Smart Pencil, Smart Link, smart fill. Usually translate the word as clever with a hint of cunning. Follow separately approved feature names: the Russian and Ukrainian Smart Filter terms are explicit exceptions. Smart Corner clever corner มุมฉลาด proposed Derived from ฉลาด (smart) and มุม (corner). A Smart Corner is a live treatment applied at a node, so a corner can be rounded, cut, or turned into an ink trap without the outline being redrawn. The treatment stays editable: change the value and the corner updates, and the underlying contour keeps its nodes. You apply it at the node rather than to the whole contour. FontLab groups it with Ink Traps among its live filters, and Vextra carries the same name. Smart Filter ฟิลเตอร์ฉลาด proposed Named glyph-selection filter; not a graphical live effect. Match this term in the Font window, Aidus settings, dialogs and help. A Smart Filter selects glyphs in the Font window using a saved condition. It filters the glyph list rather than changing outlines or applying graphical effects. Follow the language core for its name: Russian and Ukrainian have explicit feature-specific translations that differ from other Smart names. spacing controls side space handles ตัวควบคุมช่องไฟ proposed Derived from ช่องไฟ (spacing); ตัวควบคุม is Apple and Microsoft th for controls. Spacing controls are the on canvas handles in the Metrics tool that let you drag sidebearings and advance widths directly in the text. sticker สติกเกอร์ proposed Microsoft and Adobe th; Royal Society spelling. A sticker is a visual note you place on a glyph in FontLab, such as a checkmark or a comment, to mark work in progress. Stickers are annotations, not font data, and are not exported. tab แท็บ proposed Microsoft and most Thai software; Apple's แถบ also means bar. A tab selects one page or document within a set. A tab character in text is a different meaning and must retain its literal representation in code. text element text block องค์ประกอบข้อความ proposed Apple th; derived from องค์ประกอบ (element). A text element is a live element that renders a string of text from another font inside a glyph. Expanding it converts the letters into contours; FontLab uses it for placeholders and quick layout tests. thickness ความหนา proposed Microsoft th and Cadson Demak articles (cadsondemak.com); kept apart from น้ำหนัก (weight). Thickness is the geometric distance across a stroke or shape. It is distinct from a typeface weight classification or weight axis. Transform แปลงรูป proposed LibreOffice and GIMP th have แปลงรูปร่าง and แปลงลักษณะ; Adobe's bare แปลง is avoided because it is also 'convert'. Transform moves, scales, rotates, slants, or flips a selection. In FontLab the Transform panel applies a numeric transformation to glyphs, elements, or a selection, and it can run across a whole font. In Fontographer the Transform tool sits in the toolbar beside Meter and Sigma. In Vexy Lines the Transform tool manipulates artwork on the canvas. A panel, a tool, and a tool again: name the app and name the surface. transformation การแปลงรูป proposed Noun derived from แปลงรูป. A transformation changes geometry, for example by moving, scaling, rotating or skewing it. Transform names the operation; transformation names the change. True Fill final black rendering เติมจริง proposed House voice, no attestation: 'real fill', short and literal. The idiom ตัวจริง ('the real thing', also 'the real letter') is the punning alternative. True Fill is a Glyph window view that renders the glyph as it will fill when exported, honoring contour direction and overlaps, instead of the editing preview. Each language renders the name in the house voice. uncheck เลิกเลือก proposed Apple th; shorter than Microsoft's ยกเลิกการเลือก. Uncheck clears a selected checkbox. The resulting behavior depends on the option controlled by that checkbox. Vexy coins Vexy coins do-not-translate Vexy coins are credits used to pay for applicable Fontographer operations. Keep Vexy capitalized and coins lowercase in English. The common noun may translate around the protected Vexy name. State a confirmed charge before the reader performs the operation, and distinguish the credit balance from money, a licence or an account. waterfall size ladder preview น้ำตก proposed Apple Font Book th: Show Waterfall Sample = แสดงตัวอย่างน้ำตก. A waterfall shows the same glyph or text at a series of sizes, one line per size, to judge spacing and rendering across sizes. The Preview panel and the TrueType hinting tool provide one. weight น้ำหนัก proposed Cadson Demak articles (cadsondemak.com) (182 hits), Apple CoreText and Google th use น้ำหนัก for typographic weight; ความหนา is kept for measured thickness. Weight describes the relative heaviness of a typeface or a value on its weight axis. It is distinct from a measured stroke thickness. whitespace ช่องว่าง proposed Microsoft and Apple th. Whitespace is text made up of spacing characters rather than visible letterforms. Preserve literal characters when they form part of code, keys or file content.

docs.title: Vector drawing
docs.text: English Fallback Thai Status Note Definition Appearance panel แผง Appearance proposed Illustrator has no Thai interface, so the panel keeps its on-screen English name after the Thai noun แผง (Adobe and Apple th for panel). The Appearance panel is Illustrator's list of what is applied to the selected object: its fills, its strokes, and its live effects, in the order they stack. You send a reader there to confirm that a Vexy effect is present, to reorder it against a stroke, or to remove it. It belongs to Illustrator rather than to our products, so its name keeps Illustrator's capitalization and never takes a short form of our making. autotrace bitmap to outline conversion เทรซอัตโนมัติ proposed FontForge th uses เทรซ and ออโต้เทรซ; Thai designers say เทรซ for tracing. อัตโนมัติ replaces the loan ออโต้. Autotrace converts a bitmap into vector paths by finding the edges in the image and fitting curves to them. The result depends on what you feed it: a clean, high contrast source traces well, and a soft or noisy one produces nodes nobody wants to edit. You prepare the image first, trace, then simplify. Tracing to outlines gives closed shapes with two edges, and tracing to centerlines gives single paths with a stroke. centerline เส้นกึ่งกลาง proposed Plain Thai for a centre line; Microsoft Publisher th has แนวกึ่งกลาง for the alignment sense. A centerline runs down the middle of a stroke rather than around its edge, so the result is a single path with a stroke weight instead of a closed outline. Tracing to centerlines suits line art, engravings, and anything that was drawn as strokes in the first place. You choose it over outline tracing when the artwork will be scaled or restroked later, since a centerline keeps one editable path where an outline gives you two edges to maintain. clipping mask มาสก์การตัด proposed Adobe Photoshop th help uses มาสก์การตัด for a clipping mask; derived from มาสก์. A clipping mask is a shape that limits what is visible of the elements below it. Name the application: in FontLab it is an element property; a FontLab Mask layer is something else. control point control handle point จุดควบคุม proposed Blender and QCAD th; the standard Thai term for a Bézier control point. A control point is an off-curve point that pulls a Bézier segment toward itself without lying on the outline. You drag it to change the curvature between two nodes. FontLab shows control points as handles attached to their nodes, so in interface text the handle is what you drag and the control point is what the file stores. Fill Grid grid of fill lines กริดการเติม proposed Derived from กริด (grid) and การเติม (fill); a Vexy Linestra panel area with no existing Thai name. The Fill Grid is the area of the Linestra panel where you choose a fill mode from a grid of previews. Below it sit the parameter rows, which hold Thickness, Spacing, Angle, Organic, Brightness, Contrast, and Source Levels. You pick in the grid first, because the parameter rows change with the mode you choose. Both words are capitalized: it is a named part of the interface rather than a description of a grid. fill mode line fill style โหมดการเติม proposed Derived from โหมด and การเติม. A fill mode is one of the named techniques that turn a source image into line work: Linear, Wave, Circular, Spiral, Halftone, Stipple, Hex, Contour, Low-Poly, Dither, Wireframe, Fractal, String Art, and ASCII among them. Each reads the brightness of the source and lays down geometry accordingly. You pick a mode, then tune its parameters. Write the mode name with its own capitalization and the words fill mode in lowercase after it. G2 continuity ความต่อเนื่อง G2 proposed Thai mathematics term for continuity; G2 stays as written. G2 continuity means two segments meet with matching curvature, not merely with matching direction. G1 keeps the tangent continuous and can still show a break in the reflection where the curvature jumps. G2 removes that break. Vextra marks G2 nodes and can enforce the condition as you edit. You reach for it on long, shallow curves and on shapes that will be seen large, where the eye finds a curvature break that it would miss at text size. Live Effect editable effect เอฟเฟกต์สด proposed No attestation, since Illustrator has no Thai interface; สด is the Thai for live (ถ่ายทอดสด). The Illustrator menu itself reads Effect. A Live Effect is an Illustrator effect that stays editable on the object it is applied to, listed in the Appearance panel and recalculated whenever the artwork beneath it changes. Vexy Linestra runs as one, so its fills follow the source artwork rather than freezing into it. You apply it from the Effect menu, under Vexy, and you expand it only when you need the result as plain paths. Expanding ends the link. off-curve point point off the curve จุดนอกเส้นโค้ง proposed No attestation; fallback 'point off the curve' translated. An off-curve point sits beside the outline and shapes a curve without touching it. A cubic segment has two, a quadratic segment one or more. FontLab shows them as handles. Use the term when the file structure is the subject; use handle when the reader drags something. on-curve point point on the curve จุดบนเส้นโค้ง proposed No attestation; fallback 'point on the curve' translated. An on-curve point lies on the outline itself and is where two segments meet. In FontLab it is a node; the term is used when the contrast with off-curve points matters, for example when a TrueType outline stores both kinds in one list. You place on-curve points at extremes so hinting and interpolation have stable anchors. outline เอาต์ไลน์ proposed Cadson Demak articles (cadsondemak.com) write เอาต์ไลน์ของตัวอักษร and Thai designers use the loan daily. Apple's เค้าโครง is the document-outline sense; FontForge's โครงร่าง is the native alternative. An outline is the set of contours that describes a glyph's shape. Say outline for the whole drawing of a glyph and contour for one closed path inside it. Some languages have one word for both; French uses contour for each. stroke เส้นขีด proposed Thai graphics software uses เส้นขีด for a stroke as opposed to a fill. Bare เส้น, the GIMP and Inkscape pick, means any line. A stroke is the line drawn along a path, with a weight, a colour, and an alignment that puts it inside, outside, or centred on the path. It is not the fill, which covers the area the path encloses. In type design the same word means a main part of a letter. The localized vector term does not automatically apply to letter anatomy: PANOSE contrast and stem thickness describe letter strokes, not an outline effect. Use the established anatomical term in those contexts (for example Polish kreska or Ukrainian штрих). stroke cap stroke end cap ปลายเส้นขีด proposed No attestation; fallback 'stroke end cap' translated. Kept apart from ปลายจบ, the typographic terminal. A stroke cap is the shape at the open end of a stroked path: flat, square or round. Start and end caps can differ, and a cap can be linked so both ends match. stroke join stroke corner shape รอยต่อเส้นขีด proposed No attestation; fallback 'stroke corner shape' translated as the join (รอยต่อ) of the stroke. A stroke join is the shape where two stroked segments meet at a corner: miter, round or bevel. It decides whether an outside corner is sharp, rounded or cut. tangent node straight-to-curve node โหนดสัมผัส proposed Thai mathematics uses เส้นสัมผัส for a tangent; applied to โหนด. A tangent node joins a straight segment to a curve so the curve leaves along the line. Its one handle stays on the line's extension. tonal map darkness map แผนที่โทนสี proposed No attestation; fallback 'darkness map' rendered with โทนสี, the Thai designers' word for tone. A tonal map is the reading of brightness across a source image that a fill uses to decide where to put geometry. Dark areas widen a strip or crowd a pattern; light areas narrow or thin it. You control the mapping with the Brightness, Contrast, and Source Levels rows, which change what counts as dark before any geometry is drawn. Adjust the map rather than the fill when the result is uniformly too heavy or too sparse. Tunni line เส้น Tunni proposed Eponym kept in Latin script after the Thai noun เส้น. A Tunni line joins the two handles of a curve segment, with a control on it that Vextra draws as a pill. Drag the control and both handles move in proportion, so the depth of the curve changes without its balance changing. You use it when a curve is the right shape but the wrong fullness, which is the correction that is slowest to make one handle at a time. Named after Eduardo Tunni, so keep the capital T.

docs.title: FontLab localization: Turkish
docs.text:
A first draft for Turkish. A model researched the guidance below and the term table in references/terms.md; no native reviewer has approved the language as a whole. Individual terms carry their own approval status; a proposed term remains proposed, and a protected name keeps its glossary spelling. The Turkish interface catalogs are unfinished machine drafts: a string found in one settles neither a term nor a rule.

Use references/terms.md, and a newer core memory when one is supplied, for terminology, definitions and review status. Keep a proposed term consistent across the interface and help, and report it as proposed. Where a native reviewer's decision or newer project data disagrees with this skill, follow it and record the change. Report only checks performed: text written with this skill is not reviewed by a native speaker and not tested in the running application until someone does that.

Use these rules with the localization principles (in fontlab-localization), Qt interface rules (in fontlab-localization) and Turkish language guide (in the FontLab writing guide). Tagged examples are quoted: FB Font Book, G3 Glyphs 3, FF FontForge, Qt the qtbase_tr catalog, MS Microsoft's style guide. The rest are constructed.

docs.title: Locale and register
docs.text:
• Turkish for Türkiye, Qt locale tr_TR. Spell by the TDK Yazım Kılavuzu.
  • Address the reader as siz through the verb ending; never write the pronoun: Seçiminizi denetleyip yeniden deneyin (FB, "Check your selection and try again"). Never sen (istiyor musun) or the stiff deneyiniz.
  • Tone: direct and neutral. Drop lütfen, exclamation marks and the product's first person.

docs.title: Grammar of interface strings
docs.text:
String Form Example Menu command, button Bare verb stem, verb last Farklı Kaydet… (G3, "Save As…") Checkbox, option Bare stem or noun phrase Her zaman etkin glifi ortala (G3) Panel or dialog title Noun phrase Hizalama Alanları (G3, "Alignment Zones") Step, prompt -(y)in imperative Font raporu türünü seçin (FB) Status, in progress Passive -iyor Fontlar Dışa Aktarılıyor (G3, "Exporting Fonts") Success Passive past -di %lld font silindi (FB, "%lld fonts were removed") Failed attempt Passive -emedi Font yüklenemedi. (FB, "Could not install font.") Present limitation Passive -emiyor; a standing rule -emez Font Silinemiyor (FB, "Cannot Remove Font"); Bu eylem geri alınamaz. (FB) Confirmation … istiyor musunuz?, … emin misiniz?, -sin mi? Seçili fontları silmek istiyor musunuz? (FB) Tooltip Third-person aorist Etkilenmiş tüm gliflerle yeni bir sekme açar. (G3)
  • The bare stem (Kaydet, Aç) is the user commanding the program; never use it to instruct the user.
  • An existing or selected object takes the accusative; a new or indefinite one stays bare: Glifi Kaldır (G3, "Remove Glyph"), Glif Ekle (G3, "Add Glyph"), Tümünü Seç (Qt).
  • A noun compound keeps its possessive ending: Font Bilgisi, Dosya Adı, never Font Bilgi.
  • Capitalization follows the English source, as macOS, Windows, Qt and Adobe do in Turkish: title case in menu commands, buttons, titles and tabs; sentence case in checkboxes, tooltips and messages. In title case ve, veya, ile, ki, de, da and the question particle stay lowercase (TDK): “%@” ile Bitiyor (FB).
  • Standard commands take Qt's words, which Windows shares: Geri Al, Yinele, Kes, Kopyala, Yapıştır, Sil, Tümünü Seç, Kapat, Tamam, İptal (macOS says Vazgeç), Uygula.

docs.title: Compact labels
docs.text:
• Drop bir and a possessive the context supplies: Cihazı Ayarla (MS, "Set Up Your Device").
  • Shorten with a shorter word or by dropping a redundant noun: Sola hizala (G3, "Align to left"). Never cut a case, possessive, passive or negative ending: the endings are the grammar.
  • Turkish has no standard interface abbreviations (MS). Keep unit symbols and the source's abbreviations; otherwise write the word. Never abbreviate a glossary term, a command verb or a name.

docs.title: Plurals and placeholders
docs.text:
Qt gives tr_TR one numerus form: numerus.cpp lists Turkish with the Japanese-style languages (nplurals=1). One translation serves every number.

  • After a number or a quantity word (birkaç, kaç, her) the noun and the verb stay singular: %n dosya, %n font silindi, never %n dosyalar. Font Book renders "%lld file" and "%lld files" alike as %lld dosya.
  • A count in %1 follows the same rule. "%1 of %2" is %1 / %2 (FB).
  • Without a number, a definite set is plural: Glifleri Kaldır (G3).

A suffix depends on the last sounds of the word it joins (vowel harmony, buffer letters, consonant softening), which a placeholder hides: never write %1’i, %1’de or %1’e. Recast:

  • The subject of a passive verb takes no suffix: %s açılamıyor (FF, "Can't open %s"), %1 bulunamadı.
