Rejected: оптичний виступ (unattested). Overshoot is the extension of a rounded or pointed shape beyond an alignment line so that it appears as tall as a flat shape. For example, an o may extend above the x-height and below the baseline. Its amount depends on the design and intended size. PostScript alignment zones can describe these overshoot regions for hinting; there is no universal percentage to apply. proportional figures natural-width figures пропорційні цифри proposed Apple CoreText (uk): Proportional Numbers = Пропорційні цифри. Rejected: пропорційні зображення (FontForge (uk)), пропорціональні. Proportional figures have individual advance widths, so a 1 takes less room than an 8. They read well in running text; tabular figures share one width for columns. The pnum feature selects them. segment сегмент proposed Inkscape (uk) and the corpus. A segment is the portion of a contour between two on-curve endpoints. It may be a straight line or a curve. A quadratic Bézier segment has one off-curve control point; a cubic segment has two. Describe the segment type and the relevant editing command rather than assuming that every curve has two handles or that changing a node type performs every conversion. serif засічка proposed Standard Ukrainian term (textbooks, Inkscape (uk), Ukrainian Wikipedia). Rejected: зарубка (Apple), сериф. A serif is the finishing stroke at the end of a stem or arm. Its shape sorts a face into the familiar classes: oldstyle, transitional, Didone, slab. You draw a serif once and reuse it as a component or an element, which keeps a family consistent and makes a late change cheap. Serifs are small, so they take the most damage at low resolution, which is where hinting and careful alignment zones earn their place. sharp гострий proposed Inkscape (uk) for a node; the corpus has it. Rejected: різкий (image sharpening). Sharp describes a pointed corner or a node at which contour direction can change abruptly. Image sharpening is a different operation. sharp node гострий вузол proposed Inkscape (uk) calls such a node гострий вузол. A sharp node joins contour segments without requiring a smooth change of direction. The handles of adjacent segments need not be collinear; a smooth node constrains their direction. stem main stroke основний штрих proposed Ukrainian textbooks (KAI lecture: Основний штрих (Stem)) and FontForge (uk) (Основні штрихи). Rejected: стем (jargon), стійка, основа (Wikipedia machine translation). A stem is a main stroke of a letter, usually the vertical one: the two uprights of an H, the single upright of an l. Stem width sets the weight of a face, and stems that disagree across a family break its rhythm. You measure a stem with the Measurement tool and record the standard widths in Font Info, where hinting and the stem links read them. Vextra reuses the word for the paired edges it detects in general artwork, not only in letters. swash flourish розчерк proposed Apple CoreText (uk) renders swash as розчерк. Rejected: широкий рукописний (FontForge (uk)), свош. A swash is a decorative flourish that extends a letter, often on a capital or a terminal. Swash alternates live in the swsh feature and in glyphs with a swash suffix. terminal stroke ending кінцевий елемент proposed KAI lecture: Кінцевий елемент (Terminal). Rejected: термінал (in software it is the console). A terminal is the end of a stroke without a serif, such as the ending of a c or f. Its shape may be rounded, angled or cut off, depending on the design. Compare related terminals across a typeface at the intended reading size. The anatomical term does not prescribe how to construct or store the shape in an editor. UPM units per type body UPM proposed Acronym kept, as FontForge (uk) keeps em. Expand in prose as одиниць на кегельний майданчик. Keep numeric controls compact: LSB/RSB (French AG/AD), UPM and PPM. Expanded terms belong in explanatory help; the full Family Dimensions Units Per eM label is an intentional exception. Team UI convention in Proteus 1751b28b0. UPM, units per em, specifies how many font units make up one em. It sets the scale for outline coordinates and metrics when a renderer converts them to a text size. Values such as 1000 and 2048 are common; TrueType outlines do not require a power of two. When changing UPM, distinguish changing the scale value from rescaling the outlines and metrics. winding direction drawing direction напрямок контуру proposed FontForge (uk) (Виправити напрямок) and the Projector Glyphs course (напрям контуру). Winding direction is the order in which a contour runs, clockwise or counter-clockwise, and it decides which areas the renderer fills. FontLab follows the PostScript convention: outer contours wind counter-clockwise and counters wind clockwise. The letter O is two contours, one each way. You check direction before you export, and reverse a contour when a counter fills solid or an outer shape turns hollow. A renderer applies the rule at draw time, so the error shows in the proof rather than in the editor. x-height small-letter height висота малих літер proposed KAI lecture: Висота малої літери (x-height); FontForge (uk) says зріст малих літер. Rejected: висота рядкових (Russianism), х-висота. The x-height is the height of a lowercase x above the baseline, and it stands for the height of the lowercase in general. It does more for apparent size than the point size does: two faces at the same size look different when their x-heights differ. You record it in Font Info so hinting and alignment zones can use it, and you draw round letters slightly above it to allow for overshoot. Write it lowercase with a hyphen, even at the start of a sentence recast to avoid one.

docs.title: Font engineering
docs.text: English Fallback Ukrainian Status Note Definition advance height висота кроку proposed Vertical counterpart of ширина кроку (advance-width); no direct attestation. The distance the text position advances vertically after a glyph. It is the vertical counterpart of advance width, not the height of the visible outline. advance width glyph box width ширина кроку proposed FontForge (uk) writes ширина кроку for the advance width (it also has лінія ширини and додаткова ширина, so it is not consistent). Rejected: ширина гліфа (Inkscape), which reads as the outline width; ширина майданчика would be the derivation from кегельний майданчик and is unattested. Advance width is the horizontal distance allocated to a glyph before layout adjustments, measured in font units. In an OpenType font, the base values are stored in the hmtx table. Kerning and other positioning operations can adjust advances during layout without rewriting those base values. Advance width differs from the visible outline width; a space can have an advance without an outline. alignment zone height band for snapping зона вирівнювання proposed FontForge (uk): Alignment zone = зона вирівнювання; the Projector Glyphs course writes зони вирівнювання. An alignment zone is a region around a common vertical alignment, such as the baseline or cap height, used in PostScript hinting. It can include the overshoot of rounded letters. A rasterizer uses zone information when fitting outlines to a pixel grid. Keep this mechanism distinct from design measurements and from the control-value and instruction mechanisms used in TrueType hinting. anchor attachment point якір proposed The plain word, attested for anchor in six general-software origins of the corpus; chosen because it stays apart from linking, snapping and attaching. Rejected: привʼязка (FontForge (uk) and Inkscape (uk)), which is generic and collides with links and attachment; a reviewer may still prefer it. An anchor is a named attachment point in a glyph that says where a mark belongs. A base letter carries a top anchor, and the accent carries a matching one, so the accent lands in the same relation on every letter that uses it. You place anchors in the Anchors and Pins panel, and FontLab uses them both to build composites and to generate mark attachment lookups in GPOS, which is what positions marks in text the font never composed itself. anti-aliasing edge smoothing згладжування proposed Corpus best pick: Apple, Microsoft, GIMP and KDE Ukrainian (згладжування шрифтів). Anti-aliasing paints partly covered pixels in intermediate shades so a rendered outline looks smooth. FontLab's preview can show anti-aliased, monochrome or subpixel rendering so you can check how hints behave under each. Write the hyphenated form. autohinting automatic screen fitting автогінтування proposed FontForge (uk): AutoHint = Автогінтування, also автоматичне гінтування. Autohinting generates hints for a font from its outlines and its declared stems and zones, in one pass over the glyphs. It is a starting point rather than a finish: it hints the regular cases well and leaves the awkward glyphs for you. You run it after the alignment zones and standard stem widths are correct in Font Info, because it reads them. Then you check the glyphs that matter at text sizes and correct by hand what the pass got wrong. axis вісь proposed FontForge (uk): Axis = Вісь; plural осі. An axis is one dimension of font variation, such as weight, width or optical size. In an OpenType variable font, each axis has a four-character tag and a minimum, default and maximum value. Registered tags, such as wght, have defined meanings. Preserve tag spelling and case, and check the axis registry when assigning a custom tag. axis map axis value mapping мапа осі proposed No attestation; plain rendering like Polish mapa osi. Rejected: відображення осі, which also reads as display. An axis map converts user coordinates on an axis, such as weight 400, to the design coordinates of the masters. It is stored in the avar table and lets a slider feel even when masters are not. bottom sidebearing нижній напівапрош proposed Derived from напівапрош; no attestation. The space below the glyph outline within its vertical advance. This value participates in vertical text spacing rather than horizontal spacing. component компонент proposed FontForge (uk): Component = Компонент; the Projector Glyphs course writes робота з компонентами. Rejected: складник (general word, not used for this object). A component is a reference to another glyph placed inside this one, so that aacute holds the a and the acute rather than copies of their outlines. Change the source glyph and every glyph that references it follows. You build composites from components, position them with anchors, and keep them as references through to export, where a TrueType flavoured font stores them in the glyf table. In FontLab a component is one kind of element reference. composite glyph assembled glyph складений гліф proposed No direct attestation; plain Ukrainian for a glyph put together from parts. Rejected: композитний гліф, складовий гліф. A composite glyph is built from references to other glyphs rather than from its own outlines: an accented letter, a currency symbol with a bar, a stacked fraction. You assemble it from components and anchor them to the base, so a change to the base or to the mark reaches every composite that uses it. Composites keep a large accented character set consistent and small. A composite that has been decomposed is no longer one, and no longer follows its sources. conversion profile export settings set профіль конвертування proposed No attestation; fallback translated in plain words. A conversion profile is the saved set of choices TransType applies to a conversion: the output format, the naming scheme, the filters, and the options that go with them. You build a profile once for a job you repeat, then run it over a new set of sources without repeating the decisions. It matters because a family converted with two different sets of options ships as two families that do not quite match, which shows up in a font menu rather than in a test. CVT table таблиця CVT proposed FontForge (uk) pattern таблиця «cvt »; tag protected, noun translated. The CVT table holds the control values that TrueType hinting instructions refer to: the stem widths, heights, and other measurements a font wants held constant across glyphs. An instruction cites a CVT entry rather than a raw number, so one change to the table reaches every glyph that cites it. You work with it through the TrueType Hinting panel. It ships in the font, alongside the instructions themselves and the prep and fpgm programs that set the machine up. design space variation range простір дизайну proposed Ukrainian Wikipedia (Варіативний шрифт) and Aspose Ukrainian documentation write простір дизайну. Rejected: дизайн-простір, простір варіацій (unattested). A design space describes the positions defined by a font project's variation axes. Masters provide source data at specified locations; instances represent results at selected locations. User coordinates and internal design coordinates may be connected by a mapping, or may have the same values. State which coordinate system a number belongs to when the distinction affects a procedure. device correction per-size pixel correction поправка для розміру proposed No attestation; fallback translated. A device correction adjusts a kerning or positioning value by whole pixels at one pixel size, to fix rounding at that size only. Stored in GPOS device tables; rarely needed on modern rasterizers. dimensions розміри proposed No direct attestation; plain word. Keep it apart from метрики (glyph spacing) and виміри (canvas measurements). The font or family vertical values, such as ascender, descender, capital height, x-height and line gap. Distinguish these values from glyph spacing and canvas measurements. element елемент proposed FontLab’s own object; the cognate is the only candidate. Keep it distinct from компонент and посилання. An element is FontLab's container for a piece of drawing inside a glyph: one or more contours, an image, or a reference to another element. A glyph holds elements, and an element holds contours, which is the layer of structure that makes a serif or a stem reusable across a family. You work with elements in the Elements panel and with the Element tool. The word is FontLab's own; other editors call the nearest thing a path group or a component. element reference shared drawing link посилання на елемент proposed Derived from посилання and елемент; write посилання where the English says only references. An element reference is a placed copy of an element that still points at the original. Edit the original and every reference updates. You use references to share a serif, a stem, or a whole letter across a family, and you decompose a reference only when a glyph genuinely needs to diverge. A component is the familiar case of an element reference: one glyph placed inside another. Keep references intact through the design phase, since decomposing early throws away the link that makes a late change cheap. family dimensions розміри родини proposed Derived from розміри; родина is the Apple Font Book word for a font family. Гарнітура stays the word for typeface in prose. The vertical values used to establish line layout for a font family. Platform-specific ascender, descender and line-gap fields belong to this group. Flex флекс proposed FontForge (uk): Flex Hints = Флекс-гінти; fixed name of the Type 1 hint, written флекс-гінт when the noun is needed. German and Polish keep Flex. Flex is a PostScript hint that flattens a shallow curve, such as a cup serif, to a straight line at small sizes. FontLab marks glyphs that carry it. Keep the name. font dimensions розміри шрифту proposed Derived from розміри; no attestation. The design dimensions of a font master, including ascender, descender, capital height and x-height. These values describe the vertical proportions of the design. font target export target цільовий шрифт proposed No attestation; fallback translated. Where the English says only target, write ціль. A font target is what TransType produces from a source: the output font, with its format, its names, and the filters applied on the way. Sources go in on one side and targets come out on the other, and one source can produce several targets. You set the target options before you convert, and you name the target in a procedure step so a reader knows which side of the conversion a setting belongs to. font unit одиниця шрифту proposed Compositional; FontForge (uk) says одиниці em. A font unit is the coordinate step of a font's design grid. UPM says how many of them make one em, so a 700 unit stem in a 1000 UPM font is 70 percent of the em. Metrics, kerning values and node coordinates are all stated in font units. fractional coordinates non-integer coordinates дробові координати proposed No attestation; plain mathematical Ukrainian. Fractional coordinates are node positions with decimal places, kept for curve fidelity while you draw. Font formats store integers, so FontLab rounds on export or when you turn on Round coordinates for the font. friendly glyph name readable glyph name зрозуміла назва гліфа proposed No attestation; fallback readable glyph name translated. Rejected: дружня назва (calque). A friendly glyph name is the readable name FontLab shows for editing, such as Aacute, as opposed to the production name written into the exported font, such as uni00C1. FontLab can keep both and convert on export. ghost hint edge-only fitting instruction однобічний гінт proposed No attestation; translates the alias one sided hint, which says what the hint does. Rejected: гінт-привид (unattested calque). A ghost hint is a PostScript hint with a special width that marks one edge, such as the top of a round letter, when there is no stem to hint. It aligns that edge to an alignment zone. hint screen fitting instruction гінт proposed FontForge (uk): гінт, in line with the 2019 orthography (English h gives г). Rejected: хінт (colloquial, Russian-influenced), підказка (the tooltip sense). A hint is a stored instruction that tells a rasterizer how to align a stem or a zone to the pixel grid at small sizes. PostScript hints describe stems and zones; TrueType hints are instructions. FontLab draws hints in the Glyph window and generates them with autohinting. The word stays English in every language. hint zone hinting height band зона гінтування proposed Derived from гінтування and зона; no attestation of the compound. A hint zone is a horizontal band, such as the baseline or the x-height, inside which a rasterizer snaps overshoots to the same pixel row. FontLab stores zones in Font Info and shows them in the Glyph window. An alignment zone is the PostScript name for the same thing; hint zone is the general term. hinting screen fitting гінтування proposed FontForge (uk) uses гінтування throughout, a regular Ukrainian verbal noun from гінтувати. Rejected: гінтинг (Ukrainian Wikipedia text; the loan form), хінтинг (Wikipedia article title), уточнення (GIMP). Hinting is the extra information a font carries so that its outlines land predictably on a pixel grid at small sizes. PostScript hinting declares stems and alignment zones and leaves the rasterizer to interpret them. TrueType hinting gives instructions that move points explicitly, with the control values in the CVT table. You work on PostScript hints in the glyph and in Font Info, and on TrueType hints with the TrueType Hinting tool and panel. Autohinting produces a starting point you then correct. instance generated design екземпляр proposed FontForge (uk) and Ukrainian Wikipedia (екземпляри дизайну). Rejected: примірник (InDesign; a copy of a book), зразок (a sample), інстанс (jargon). An instance is a particular result at a location in a font's variation space. A named instance, such as Semibold, gives a selected location a name that applications can present. Other locations need not have names. In FontLab, configured instances can be exported as static fonts or included as named instances in a variable font. interpolation інтерполяція proposed FontForge (uk) and Ukrainian Wikipedia. Interpolation calculates values between source values. In font design, it can calculate outlines, metrics and other data from masters at specified design-space locations. Outline interpolation requires corresponding contour and point structures. Structural compatibility makes the calculation possible, but does not guarantee a good drawing: inspect intermediate results as well as the masters. Extrapolation calculates beyond the source range. kern exception pair spacing exception виняток кернінгу proposed Derived from кернінг; no attestation. A kern exception is a pair value that overrides what the classes would otherwise apply. One member of a class rarely behaves like the rest, and the exception says so without breaking the class apart. You create one in the Kerning panel by kerning the single pair while its classes stay in place. Keep exceptions few: a class with many exceptions is the wrong class, and the cheaper fix is to split it rather than to list every disagreement. kerning pair spacing correction кернінг proposed Adobe, Microsoft, Ukrainian textbooks and designers; FontForge (uk) spells it кернінґ, but the 2019 orthography writes г in common nouns. Verb: кернити; adjective: кернінговий. Rejected: апрош (Inkscape (uk)). Kerning adjusts the spacing of particular glyph combinations beyond their normal advances. A pair such as AV may need a different gap from the one produced by its unadjusted metrics. OpenType fonts commonly store horizontal kerning in GPOS lookups associated with the kern feature; some formats and workflows use a separate kern table. Name the mechanism when it matters to export or compatibility. kerning class pair spacing group клас кернінгу proposed FontForge (uk): клас кернінґу, respelled with г. The Projector Glyphs course says кернінгова група. A kerning class groups glyphs that need the same kerning. You put every glyph that behaves alike on one side into one class, then kern the class once instead of kerning each pair inside it. FontLab applies the class value to every member pair and keeps single pairs as exceptions where a member needs its own value. Classes matter because a text face carries thousands of readable pairs, and a hand kerned list of that size is unmaintainable. FontLab writes the result into GPOS as class based positioning. kerning pair spacing-corrected pair кернінгова пара proposed FontForge (uk): кернінґові пари; Ukrainian design writing: кернінгові пари. Write пара where the English says only pair. A kerning pair associates two glyphs, or two kerning classes, with a spacing adjustment. In horizontal kerning, a negative value normally reduces the gap and a positive value increases it. An individual glyph pair may provide an exception to class kerning, but it can also exist without a class rule. Check pairs in representative text as well as in isolation. left sidebearing лівий напівапрош proposed Derived from напівапрош. Rejected: ліва опора (FontForge (uk)). Keep numeric controls compact: LSB/RSB (French AG/AD), UPM and PPM. Expanded terms belong in explanatory help; the full Family Dimensions Units Per eM label is an intentional exception. Team UI convention in Proteus 1751b28b0. The horizontal space between the glyph origin and the left edge of its outline. It contributes to the glyph advance width and its spacing. Lib Lib proposed Identifier of the UFO and VFJ data dictionary; kept as in German and Polish. Lib is the custom metadata dictionary of a font or a master, mirroring the UFO lib and stored in VFJ. Scripts and tools keep their own keys there. line gap міжрядковий проміжок proposed Inkscape (uk) uses міжрядковий проміжок for the space between lines; FontForge (uk) has проміжок лінії. Rejected: інтерліньяж, the whole baseline-to-baseline distance (used for line height). The line gap is extra vertical space between lines that a font recommends beyond ascender and descender. hhea and OS/2 each store one. line height інтерліньяж proposed Ukrainian textbooks: Інтерліньяж (Linespace), the distance between baselines, which is this definition. Rejected: висота рядка (CSS calque). The distance between successive text baselines. It includes the relevant ascender, descender and line-gap contributions; line gap alone is only the additional space. link metrics tie spacing to another glyph повʼязати метрики proposed No attestation; plain verb for tying a value to its source. Rejected: звʼязати (to tie up). Link metrics ties a glyph's sidebearing or advance width to another glyph or to an expression, so the value follows its source. FontLab shows linked metrics with the expression and updates them when the source changes. linked metrics повʼязані метрики proposed Derived from повʼязати метрики. Glyph spacing values linked to another glyph or to an expression. Updating the source or expression changes the dependent advance width or sidebearings. mark attachment combining mark positioning розташування діакритиків proposed Apple CoreText (uk) writes варіанти розташування діакритиків; derived from діакритик. Rejected: долучення позначок (FontForge (uk)). Mark attachment positions a combining mark relative to a base glyph, a ligature component or another mark. OpenType GPOS lookups describe the anchor relationships, and the shaping engine applies the positioning during layout. FontLab can generate attachment code from suitable anchors. Check the relevant generation settings and test combinations, including stacked marks, rather than assuming that every anchor automatically becomes a lookup. master source design майстер proposed No settled Ukrainian term: майстер is the Ukrainian form of the international word (майстер-клас, майстер-копія) and a Ukrainian paper on variable fonts writes майстерні варіанти. Rejected: мастер (reads as a Russianism), шаблон and зразок (corpus, the slide-template sense), головний шрифт (Ukrainian Wikipedia), основа (FontForge (uk)). A master provides source outlines and other font data at a specified location in a design space. Masters can describe weight, width or other variations, including intermediate locations. FontLab uses corresponding data from masters to calculate instances. For outline interpolation, check contour and point compatibility in each affected glyph; the word master alone does not guarantee that every glyph is present or compatible. master compatibility matching master structure сумісність майстрів proposed Derived from майстер; no attestation. Master compatibility is the condition every glyph must meet before it can interpolate: the same number of contours in the same order, with the same number of nodes and the same start point in each. FontLab reports incompatible glyphs and gives you Matchmaker to repair them by matching contours and start points between masters. Fix compatibility before you tune shapes, because a repair that reorders nodes moves every curve that depends on them. metrics метрики proposed FontForge (uk) (метрика) and the Projector Glyphs course (способи задавання метрик); plural as in English. Metrics are the measurements that place a glyph in a line: its advance width and its two sidebearings. Vertical metrics are a separate set, the font wide values for ascender, descender, and line gap. You work on horizontal metrics in the Metrics panel and with the Metrics tool, and on vertical metrics in Font Info. Say which set you mean whenever a page discusses both, because a reader who applies a horizontal instruction to the vertical fields breaks line spacing everywhere the font is used. metrics expression вираз метрик proposed Derived from метрики; no attestation. An expression that calculates a glyph advance width or sidebearing from other values. It describes a spacing relationship rather than a canvas measurement. metrics key ключ метрик proposed Derived from метрики; no attestation. A glyph reference or expression used to derive a spacing value. The referenced value determines an advance width or sidebearing. pin шпилька proposed Issue 160 catalog family review: named point inside an element, distinct from a glyph-layer anchor. Proteus Resources/helptips.json def.anchorpin defines the behavior. Preserve this term across panel, tool, action and help labels; proposed terminology, not native-team approval. A pin is a named point inside an element. Use pins to position elements with expressions and to attach elements to each other. An anchor is a named point in a glyph layer, used for component placement and mark attachment. Create either with the Guides tool and edit it in the Anchors and Pins panel. PPM pixels per type body PPM proposed Acronym kept as in hinting fields. Expand in prose as пікселів на кегельний майданчик. Keep numeric controls compact: LSB/RSB (French AG/AD), UPM and PPM. Expanded terms belong in explanatory help; the full Family Dimensions Units Per eM label is an intentional exception. Team UI convention in Proteus 1751b28b0. PPM, pixels per em, is the size at which a rasterizer renders a font: how many pixels one em occupies. TrueType hints, device corrections and bitmap strikes are specified per PPM. In explanatory prose expand it; in hinting fields the short form is usual. production glyph name shipping glyph name технічна назва гліфа proposed No attestation; the name written into the exported font. Rejected: виробнича назва (calque). A production glyph name is the name written into the exported font, chosen for compatibility with tools and the Adobe Glyph List, such as uni00C1 rather than Aacute. rendering drawing on screen рендеринг proposed Common in Ukrainian writing on font rasterization; spelled with и after р by the orthography. Rejected: візуалізація (Adobe, GIMP), обробка (FontForge (uk)). Rendering is the conversion of an outline into pixels on a screen or a printer. The rasterizer of the operating system or of FontLab's preview reads the outline, applies the hints and paints the result. FontLab previews rendering at chosen pixel sizes so you can judge hints. Rasterization names the same step from the pixel side. required glyphs mandatory glyphs обовʼязкові гліфи proposed No attestation; fallback translated. Required glyphs are the ones the OpenType specification and common tools expect at the start of a font: .notdef, NULL or uni0000, CR or uni000D and space. FontLab can add them on export. right sidebearing правий напівапрош proposed Derived from напівапрош. Rejected: права опора (FontForge (uk)). Keep numeric controls compact: LSB/RSB (French AG/AD), UPM and PPM. Expanded terms belong in explanatory help; the full Family Dimensions Units Per eM label is an intentional exception. Team UI convention in Proteus 1751b28b0. The horizontal space between the right edge of a glyph outline and the end of its advance width. It contributes to spacing. sidebearing side space напівапрош proposed Ukrainian textbooks: Напівапрош (Side bearing), half of the міжлітерний проміжок (KAI lecture, HNEU textbook). Rejected: опора (FontForge (uk)), півапрош. A sidebearing is the space between a glyph's outline and the edge of its advance width: the left sidebearing before the shape, the right sidebearing after it. Together with the advance width it sets how the glyph spaces against every other glyph, which is the work that carries a text face further than kerning does. You edit sidebearings in the Metrics panel or with the Metrics tool, one glyph at a time or across a selection, and you check them in a word rather than in isolation. size розмір proposed Standard word; the type size itself is кегль. The size of an object or the chosen size of displayed text. Name a specific width or height when only one direction is intended. spacing апроші proposed Ukrainian textbooks define апрош as the міжлітерний проміжок made of two напівапроші; the activity is розставляння апрошів. Rejected: спейсинг (Projector course, jargon), інтервали (Apple; any interval). The adjustment of glyph advance widths and sidebearings to establish the space between letters. Kerning makes additional adjustments to particular pairs. standard stem reference stem width стандартна товщина штриха proposed No attestation; describes StdHW and StdVW, which are widths. Standard stems are the representative horizontal and vertical stem widths declared in a font for hinting. The rasterizer snaps stems near those widths to the same pixel count, so like stems stay alike at small sizes. stem link stem tie звʼязок штриха proposed No attestation; fallback stem tie translated with штрих. A stem link ties two edges of a stroke together as a stem, so hinting can hold their distance as the size changes. A vertical link governs a horizontal measurement and a horizontal link governs a vertical one. You add links in the glyph, either by hand or from an autohinting pass, and you keep them consistent with the standard stem widths declared in Font Info. Vextra reuses the term for the paired edges it detects in artwork that is not type. styling group name назва стильової групи proposed No attestation; compositional. The styling group name, SGN, ties together the styles an application reaches through its bold and italic buttons, and the styling link value and styling link name say which slot each style takes in that group. The mechanism is older than typographic family names and narrower: four slots, no more. You set these fields in TransType when a family has to behave correctly in applications that still drive style selection from those buttons. subsetting cutting down a font створення підмножини proposed FontForge (uk): Subsetting = створення підмножин. Rejected: підклас (Font Book). Subsetting exports only part of a font, such as the glyphs a page uses or one codepage, to make a smaller file. The OS/2 embedding bits can forbid it. top sidebearing верхній напівапрош proposed Derived from напівапрош; no attestation. The space above the glyph outline within its vertical advance. This value participates in vertical text spacing rather than horizontal spacing. tracking uniform letter spacing трекінг proposed Ukrainian textbooks (KAI: кернінг, трекінг), Adobe and design writing. Rejected: відстеження, стеження (corpus pick, the surveillance sense). Tracking changes the spacing across a run of text, rather than correcting particular pairs as kerning does. Layout applications apply it to text. TransType's Tracking filter changes spacing in the font data itself. That changes the font's starting metrics; a layout application can still apply additional tracking to text set in the resulting font. TrueType instruction pixel fitting instruction інструкція TrueType proposed FontForge (uk) uses інструкції for TrueType instructions. A TrueType instruction is one step of the program a TrueType font runs to fit an outline to the pixel grid. Instructions are the TrueType form of hints. FontLab writes them from visual TrueType hints and can keep the ones a font already has. Say instruction for the code and hint for what the reader draws. typographic family name типографічна назва родини proposed No attestation; compositional, with родина as in Apple Font Book (Назва родини). The typographic family name, TFN, is the name that groups every style of a family under one entry, and the typographic style name, TSN, is what distinguishes a style inside it. They sit beside the older four style family and style names that legacy applications read. You set them in TransType and in Font Info, and you keep them consistent across a family, because an app that reads these fields builds its font menu from them. update metrics оновити метрики proposed Derived from метрики; standard verb. Recalculate glyph spacing values from their links or expressions. This command updates the advance widths and sidebearings that depend on those relationships. variable font варіативний шрифт proposed Ukrainian Wikipedia, the KSADA textbook (2026), a KAI paper on variable fonts (2025) and Ukrainian design writing. Rejected: змінний шрифт (InDesign), which a reviewer may prefer as the native word. A variable font contains data for design variation along one or more axes. Applications select axis values and calculate the corresponding outlines and other variable data. Named instances identify selected locations, but users are not limited to those locations when the application exposes axis controls. A variable font's supported range depends on its data; it need not contain every style in the family. variation location position in the variation range положення proposed No attestation; a point in the простір дизайну, as German Position and Polish położenie. A variation location is a point in the design space, given as one value per axis. Masters and instances each have one, and the Variations panel slider shows the current one. vertical advance glyph box height висота кроку proposed Vertical counterpart of ширина кроку; no direct attestation. The vertical advance is the distance a glyph advances in vertical text, the counterpart of advance width for East Asian layout. Stored in vmtx. vertical metrics вертикальні метрики proposed Derived from метрики; no attestation. The font-wide vertical values used for line layout, including ascender, descender and line gap. FontLab groups these as dimensions, distinct from glyph spacing metrics. visual kerning shape-measured spacing correction візуальний кернінг proposed Derived from кернінг; no attestation. Visual kerning is kerning that FontLab proposes by measuring the shapes, so that a font gets a usable first pass without a person typing thousands of values. You run it over a selection, then review what it produced, because a measurement of two outlines does not know about the words a reader will meet. Treat the result as a draft: keep the pairs it got right, correct the ones it did not, and kern the difficult pairs by eye in real words. weight axis thickness axis вісь насиченості proposed Derived from насиченість and вісь; no attestation of the compound. Rejected: вісь ваги. The weight axis, tag wght, varies stroke thickness from light to bold. In a variable font it is the most common axis; its master locations use the usWeightClass scale, such as 400 for Regular and 700 for Bold. weight class клас насиченості proposed FontForge (uk): Weight Class = Клас насиченості. The weight class is the OS/2 value from 100 to 900 that tells applications how heavy a style is, with 400 for Regular and 700 for Bold. Style linking and menus rely on it. width axis narrow-to-wide axis вісь ширини proposed Derived from ширина and вісь; no attestation of the compound. The width axis, tag wdth, varies letter proportions from condensed to extended. It is distinct from advance width, which is the spacing of one glyph, and from the geometric width of a shape. Its scale is a percentage of normal width. width class клас ширини proposed FontForge (uk): Width Class = Клас ширини. The width class is the OS/2 value from 1, ultra condensed, to 9, ultra expanded, that tells applications how wide a style is. It is a classification, not the width axis value and not the advance width.

docs.title: OpenType
docs.text: English Fallback Ukrainian Status Note Definition Adobe Glyph List Adobe Glyph List do-not-translate The Adobe Glyph List maps standard glyph names to Unicode codepoints, so that a glyph named aacute is understood as U plus 00E1 by any tool that follows it. You name glyphs by it wherever it covers the character, because tools and text engines can then infer the mapping without being told twice. Where it does not cover a glyph, you fall back to a consistent scheme of your own and assign codepoints explicitly. Write the name in full on first mention, then AGL. alternate glyph glyph variant варіант гліфа proposed Derived from варіант (Apple CoreText uk: Варіант, Контекстні варіанти); the fallback glyph variant translated. Adobe Ukrainian help says альтернативні гліфи, the rejected alternative. An alternate glyph is another form of the same character, selected through an OpenType feature such as salt or a stylistic set. Its name usually carries a suffix, as in a.alt or g.ss01. cmap cmap do-not-translate The cmap table maps character codes to glyph indices. Its Unicode subtables provide the initial mapping used in text rendering; other subtables support particular encodings or variation sequences. FontLab generates these mappings from the project's encoding data. A glyph without its own Unicode assignment can still appear in typed text through substitution, such as a ligature or alternate selected by the shaping engine. code page legacy character table кодова сторінка proposed Microsoft Ukrainian glossary; standard computing term. A code page is a numbered legacy encoding, such as Windows 1250 for Central European languages, that maps one byte to one character. The OS/2 table lists the code pages a font supports, and FontLab derives that list from the glyphs present. Write two words. color font table таблиця кольорового шрифту proposed No attestation; compositional, with таблиця for a font table as in FontForge (uk). Colour-font tables store data for colour glyph rendering. Formats include COLR with CPAL, SVG, sbix, and CBDT with CBLC. They differ in how they describe vector or bitmap content and in application support. Including several formats can extend coverage, but does not guarantee rendering in every application. Identify the exported formats and test the intended targets. contextual alternates context-dependent variants контекстні варіанти proposed Apple CoreText (uk), Adobe InDesign (uk) and Microsoft Word (uk) agree. Rejected: контекстні альтернативи. Contextual alternates, the calt feature, cover substitutions an app makes because of what sits around a glyph rather than because a reader asked. In a script face the text engine replaces an entry stroke after a letter that already ends in one, and in a face with repeating shapes it replaces the second of a pair. You write the rules with context in feature code, and apps usually leave calt on by default, which makes it the feature most likely to surprise you when a rule is too broad. cursive attachment joined-script connection курсивне зʼєднання proposed No settled term; fallback translated. Rejected: долучення курсиву (FontForge (uk)), which reads as adding an italic. Cursive attachment joins glyphs by matching an exit anchor of one glyph to the entry anchor of the next, so connected scripts such as Arabic and Nastaliq flow. It is the curs feature, built from anchors. design languages цільові мови proposed No attestation; follows the reviewed German Zielsprachen and Polish języki docelowe. Design languages, the meta table dlng record, list the languages the typeface was designed for. Supported languages, slng, list every language it can set. Both are language tags, not feature tags. encoding кодування proposed FontForge (uk), Apple, Adobe and Microsoft. An encoding maps character codes to glyphs. Unicode is the encoding modern fonts use; legacy encodings such as Mac Roman or a code page map one byte to one glyph. FontLab shows the font in a chosen encoding in the Font window and writes the cmap from it. Say encoding for the mapping and code page for a numbered legacy table. feature code layout rule code код функцій proposed Derived from функція; no attestation. The FEA abbreviation stays. Feature code is the text syntax that describes OpenType features: classes, lookups, substitution and positioning rules, grouped into features by tag. It is usually called FEA, after the file extension. You edit it in the Features panel, compile it to check for errors, and keep it under the same review as the drawings, since a rule that fires on the wrong glyph is as visible as a wrong outline. FontLab compiles it into GSUB and GPOS at export. fractions дроби proposed Corpus best pick; FontForge (uk) and Apple CoreText (uk). Fractions are numerical forms such as ½. In OpenType, the frac feature supports diagonal fraction composition through glyph substitution. A font may provide precomposed fraction glyphs, numerator and denominator forms, or both. The separate numr and dnom features provide numerator and denominator forms. Do not substitute the sups and subs feature names for these mechanisms or promise support for every input sequence without testing it. glyph index glyph number індекс гліфа proposed FontForge (uk): індекс гліфа; Apple Font Book (uk): індекс гліфу. A glyph index is the number a glyph occupies in the font's own order, counting from zero. Text engines work in indices after the cmap has done its job, and binary tables reference glyphs by index rather than by name. You rarely set one by hand, but you meet it when you inspect a compiled font or debug a lookup that fires on the wrong glyph. The index depends on glyph order, so it changes when the order does. glyph name назва гліфа proposed FontForge (uk): назва гліфа. Rejected: імʼя гліфа (Russian pattern; Ukrainian gives things a назва). A glyph name identifies a glyph in an editing project, feature code or a tool's data. Names such as a, a.sc and a.alt can distinguish related drawings. They are separate from Unicode assignments and glyph indices, and need not survive in every exported format. After renaming a glyph, check references in feature code, classes and scripts, including references the editor cannot update automatically. GPOS GPOS do-not-translate GPOS is the OpenType table that holds positioning: kerning, mark attachment, cursive attachment, and any rule that moves a glyph without replacing it. FontLab writes your kerning here, as pairs and as class based positioning, and builds the mark lookups from your anchors. You reach it through feature code rather than by editing the table. A font may also carry a legacy kern table; modern text engines read GPOS and many ignore the other. GSUB GSUB do-not-translate GSUB is the OpenType table containing glyph-substitution lookups. It supports operations such as replacing a glyph with an alternate, forming a ligature or selecting a form from its context. FontLab compiles feature code into these structures. To diagnose a missing substitution, check the glyphs, compiled rules, feature selection, language and shaping order in the target application. ligature joined letters лігатура proposed FontForge (uk), Apple CoreText (uk), Adobe. A ligature is a glyph used to represent a sequence of characters, such as fi. OpenType substitution can replace several glyphs with one ligature glyph. The liga and dlig features distinguish standard and discretionary ligatures. Shaping does not change the underlying text; whether a later document export preserves searchable text also depends on that export and its text mappings. localized forms language-specific variants локалізовані форми proposed FontForge (uk), Adobe InDesign (uk) and Krita (uk). Localized forms are glyph variants selected for a text run's language. The OpenType locl feature can provide these substitutions, for example Bulgarian forms of Cyrillic letters. The shaping engine needs the relevant language information, which the application may obtain from a setting or other context. The substitution changes glyph selection, not the underlying characters or their codepoints. lookup procedure процедура approved User/team procedure fallback. No sufficiently strong established OpenType-specific alternative verified in the reviewed primary sources. Keep the approved contextual Rules panel title. Preserve literal FEA lookup/lookupflag keywords, identifiers and OpenType structure names. Ordinary search senses are separate. A lookup groups substitution or positioning rules of one type in GSUB or GPOS. Features reference lookups, and several features can share one. The shaping engine selects features and may process them in script-specific stages; within a stage, LookupList order matters. Source-code order alone does not describe the complete shaping sequence. Inspect the compiled tables and the target engine when diagnosing ordering problems. mark glyph combining mark glyph гліф діакритика proposed Derived from діакритик and гліф; no attestation. A mark glyph is an accent or other combining mark that attaches to a base glyph through anchors. The GDEF table classes it as a mark so shaping engines position it rather than advancing past it. nonspacing mark zero-width combining mark діакритик нульової ширини proposed No settled term; fallback translated. A nonspacing mark is the Unicode general category Mn: a combining mark with zero advance, such as a combining acute. It differs from FontLab's nonspacing element, which is a property of an element inside a glyph. oldstyle figures lowercase-style figures мінускульні цифри proposed Apple CoreText (uk): Oldstyle Figures = Мінускульні цифри, the pair of маюскульні. Rejected: давні форми написання, малюнки у старому стилі (FontForge (uk)). Oldstyle figures are numerals with varying heights, often including forms with ascenders and descenders. The OpenType onum feature selects them when provided by the font. Figure height and figure width are separate choices: oldstyle figures can be proportional or tabular. Use tabular widths when numerals must align in columns, whether their forms are oldstyle or lining. OpenType class layout glyph group клас OpenType proposed Compositional; FontForge (uk) uses клас. An OpenType class is a named group of glyphs that feature code can address at once, written with an at sign before the name. One rule over two classes replaces a page of single rules, and one edit to a class reaches every rule that cites it. You define classes in the Classes panel or in feature code, and you keep their order stable, because a substitution between two classes pairs them by position. Kerning classes are a separate mechanism with the same idea. OpenType feature layout feature функція OpenType proposed Adobe Ukrainian help: функції OpenType. Rejected: можливість OpenType (InDesign), модифікація (FontForge (uk)). An OpenType feature identifies typographic behaviour through a four-character tag, such as liga, smcp or ss01. Feature records reference substitution or positioning lookups. In FontLab, you can write feature code and compile it into the font. Whether and when a feature is applied depends on the shaping engine, script, language and application settings; not every feature is a user-controlled switch. OS/2 table таблиця OS/2 proposed Tag protected, noun translated; FontForge (uk) pattern таблиця + tag. The OS/2 table carries the font's metadata for applications: vertical metrics, weight and width classes, embedding permissions, the panose values, and the codepage and Unicode range bits that say what the font covers. You fill it from Font Info rather than by hand, and you check it before release, because a wrong weight class puts a font in the wrong slot in a menu and wrong vertical metrics change line spacing in every browser. Write it with the slash: OS/2. Private Use Area Private Use Area do-not-translate A private-use area is one of three Unicode blocks whose codepoints can receive meanings by private agreement. Different fonts or systems may assign different meanings to the same private-use codepoint. Use a documented agreement when encoding custom symbols there. An alternate glyph reached through a feature does not require its own private-use assignment. single substitution одинарна підстановка proposed FontForge (uk): Single Substitution = Одинарна підстановка. A single substitution replaces one glyph with one other glyph, the simplest GSUB lookup type. Small caps, stylistic alternates and localized forms are mostly built from it. small caps small capitals капітель proposed Apple CoreText (uk), FontForge (uk), Scribus (uk) and Ukrainian textbooks. Rejected: малі прописні, зменшені великі літери. Small caps are capital shapes drawn at roughly lowercase height, with their own weight and width rather than scaled capitals. Apps apply the smcp feature to put them in place of lowercase letters, and c2sc to put them in place of capitals, so a run set in both features becomes uniform. You draw them as separate glyphs, usually with a dot sc suffix, and write both features. Scaled capitals look thin beside real text, which is the reason to draw them rather than let an app fake them. stylistic set стилістичний набір proposed Apple CoreText (uk) writes стилістичні набори (Альтернативні стилістичні набори). Rejected: набір стилів (Microsoft and one Apple string; reads as a set of styles). A stylistic set is a numbered group of alternate glyphs a reader can switch on, from ss01 through ss20. Each set holds alternates that belong together: a single storey a with a matching g, a set of flat topped figures. You name each set in the font so an app can show a readable label instead of a number, and you keep one idea per set. A set that mixes unrelated alternates gives a reader nothing they can decide about. tabular figures equal-width figures табличні цифри proposed Apple CoreText (uk) writes табличні числа and таблична цифра; цифри as in маюскульні цифри. Rejected: табличні зображення (FontForge (uk)). Tabular figures all carry the same advance width, so columns of numbers line up whatever digits they contain. Apps apply the tnum feature to put them in place of proportional figures. You draw them as a separate set and give every one the same width, centring the narrow digits inside it. They matter in any table, price list, or running total, and they look loose in prose, which is why a font offers both sets rather than choosing for the reader. Unicode codepoint character code кодова позиція Unicode proposed FontForge (uk) writes позиція у Unicode, and Unicode stays in Latin as in Apple and FontForge. Compact form: код Unicode. Rejected: кодова точка (calque). A Unicode codepoint is an integer from U+0000 to U+10FFFF. Not every codepoint has an assigned character. Write it with U+ and at least four hexadecimal digits, as in U+0041 for A. In a font editor, a glyph's Unicode assignment connects it to an encoded character; the exported cmap records the relevant mapping. variation selector variant picker character селектор варіантів proposed No settled term; derived from варіант. FontForge (uk) says вибір варіанта. A variation selector is a Unicode character that follows a base character to request a specific glyph form. The pair is a variation sequence, mapped in the cmap format 14 subtable; a default mapping points at the base glyph. writing system система письма proposed Attested in the corpus; писемність is the word for a script. Rejected: вид писемності (Microsoft). A writing system is the set of characters and rules a language writes with, such as Latin, Cyrillic or Arabic. OpenType calls it a script and identifies it by a four letter tag. Say writing system in prose and script tag for the identifier, so the reader does not confuse it with a Python script.

docs.title: File formats
docs.text: English Fallback Ukrainian Status Note Definition AI file AI file do-not-translate An AI file is an Adobe Illustrator document, and it is the container the Vexy Illustrator plug-ins work inside. It holds paths, strokes, fills, appearances, and the live effects that a plug-in adds. You do not export an AI file from the plug-ins; you work in one. Write it as an AI file or an Illustrator document, never as an ai, and name Adobe Illustrator in full on first mention in the same document. AIP AIP do-not-translate An AIP file is an Adobe Illustrator plug-in binary, and it is how Vexy Linestra and Vexy Vextra reach Illustrator. The filenames close up the product name, VexyLinestra.aip and VexyVextra.aip, while prose keeps the space. You copy the file into the Illustrator plug-ins folder, whose name the operating system may show translated, and restart Illustrator so it loads. Name the file exactly as it ships, since a renamed plug-in does not load. FLREQ FLREQ do-not-translate An FLREQ file is a licence request the application writes when a machine cannot reach the licensing service, and an FLLIC file is the response that activates it. You send the request from the machine that needs the licence, receive the response, and open it there. The pair exists for machines that stay offline, so name both files in a procedure that uses either, and say which machine each step happens on. Fog.net Fog.net do-not-translate Fog.net is Fontographer's project data format, and fognet is the Python module that reads and writes it from a script. A project file carries the extension .fog. You meet the format when you script against a project or move one between machines, rather than in ordinary editing, where the dashboard handles saving. The module name is lowercase, as Python module names are, and it goes in code font wherever it appears in prose. Glyphs file Glyphs file do-not-translate A Glyphs file is the source format of the Glyphs editor, and FontLab reads and writes it so that a project can move between the two. It holds masters, glyphs, metrics, and features in one text file. You use it when a collaborator works in the other editor, and you check the result after the trip, because two editors model masters and components in ways that do not correspond exactly. Write it as a Glyphs file, not as a glyphs. Lines file Lines file do-not-translate A Lines file is the native document of Vexy Lines, holding the source image, the fills applied to it, and the settings that produced the result. You save to it while you work and export vector artwork when you are finished, because the export keeps the result and not the recipe. Write it as a Lines file with a capital L when you name the format, and as the extension in lowercase with a dot when you mean the file suffix. OTF OTF do-not-translate OTF is the usual filename extension for an OpenType font with PostScript outlines. These use cubic curves stored in CFF or CFF2 data. State the outline flavour when it matters: OpenType fonts with TrueType outlines also support OpenType layout features. The .otf extension alone does not establish which features, colour formats or variation capabilities a font contains. SVG SVG do-not-translate SVG is the vector graphics format, and it names two different things in this documentation: a graphic file that a drawing tool exports, and the SVG table inside a colour font. Say which you mean. You export SVG artwork from the Vexy products, and you meet the SVG table when you build a colour font in FontLab. A sentence that says SVG support without saying which one leaves a reader to guess. TTC TTC do-not-translate TTC is the usual filename extension for a TrueType font collection: several fonts stored in one file. Collection members can share tables, reducing duplication where their data is identical. A collection is a packaging format, not an interpolation model. Distinguish its individual fonts from named instances within a variable font. TTF TTF do-not-translate TTF is the usual filename extension for a font with TrueType outlines, which use quadratic curves. An OpenType TTF can contain layout features and variation data. Exporting cubic source outlines to this flavour requires curve conversion, which can change the point structure and approximate the original geometry. Check the exported outlines at the intended sizes. Type 1 Type 1 do-not-translate Type 1 is an older PostScript outline-font format. It remains relevant when opening archived fonts or explaining conversion workflows. Support depends on the application and version, so identify the target when discussing compatibility. Converting a Type 1 font to OpenType does not automatically supply missing Unicode mappings or new layout features. UFO UFO do-not-translate UFO, Unified Font Object, is an open source-font format. UFO 3 stores glyph layers, font information, kerning, groups and optional feature code in a directory package or ZIP archive. It also allows images and application-specific data. Interchange depends on what both applications support; a UFO export does not by itself guarantee that every editor-specific property survives. VFB VFB do-not-translate VFB is the native source format of FontLab Studio 5. FontLab 8 can open and export it, but the format cannot represent every feature of a FontLab 8 project. Use VFC or VFJ for ongoing work in FontLab 8. Name VFB when explaining migration or an exchange workflow that requires the older format, and check the exported result for unsupported data. VFC VFC do-not-translate VFC is FontLab's native binary format, and the one you work in. It holds everything the editor knows: masters, elements, references, anchors, kerning, features, and the project settings that no font format carries. You save to it while you design and export to OTF or TTF when you ship. Write the format in capitals when you name it and in lowercase with a dot when you mean the extension. Its sibling VFJ stores the same content as text. VFJ VFJ do-not-translate VFJ is FontLab's JSON source format. It provides a text representation of a FontLab project for workflows that need readable or scriptable data. Use it as a source format, not an installable font. When exchanging files between FontLab versions or external tools, check that the receiving tool supports the data the project uses. WOFF2 WOFF2 do-not-translate WOFF2 is a compressed font format for web delivery. Its encoding uses font-specific transformations and Brotli compression. Export it for web use and test the resulting font in the target browsers. The size saving depends on the source font and its contents; do not promise a fixed reduction or infer available features from the extension.

docs.title: Interface
docs.text: English Fallback Ukrainian Status Note Definition action дія proposed Apple, Adobe and Microsoft Ukrainian all use дія. An action is an operation you can invoke in the application. An action label names the operation; help explains its effect. add додати proposed FontForge (uk), Adobe, Apple and Microsoft; standard platform verb. Add inserts another item into the current collection or selection. Name the item when the surrounding control does not make it clear. alternate варіант proposed Apple CoreText (uk) names alternates варіанти (Stylistic Alternates = Стилістичні варіанти); Adobe, Apple and Microsoft agree on контекстні варіанти. Rejected: альтернатива (FontForge (uk): стилістичні альтернативи), альтернативний (Microsoft, Krita). An alternate is a different glyph form for the same character or purpose. The context determines how you select or substitute that form. anchor cloud attachment point cloud хмара якорів proposed No attestation; compound derived from якір. Where the English says only cloud, write хмара. The anchor cloud previews the marks that attach to an anchor by showing them faintly around the glyph in the Glyph window. It checks mark positioning without leaving the base glyph. auto layer recipe-built layer автошар proposed No attestation; closed compound derived from шар, like Polish autowarstwa. The 2019 orthography writes авто- together. An auto layer builds a glyph from a recipe, such as A plus acute, and rebuilds it when the parts change. Turn auto off to edit the glyph by hand. autohint автогінтування proposed FontForge (uk): AutoHint = Автогінтування. Command label as a noun, the same word as the process; in a sentence write виконати автогінтування. Autohint is the command to generate hints automatically. Use autohinting when naming the process rather than the command. Brush Пензель proposed Inkscape (uk), Adobe, Krita and GIMP Ukrainian. Rejected: щітка. The Brush tool draws a stroke freehand, and what the stroke becomes differs by product. In FontLab and Fontographer the Brush keeps the path you drew as a centreline and generates the thick outline from it, so the drawing stays editable until you expand it into ordinary contours. In Vexy Lines the Brush paints masks by hand, and a mask decides where a layer's fills can draw rather than being artwork itself. Name the application in any sentence where a reader could take one tool for the other. collapse стягнути proposed The definition is to pull the selected nodes into one point, not to fold a panel; no attestation. Rejected: згорнути (corpus pick, folds interface elements). Collapse aligns the selected nodes to one point. In the Contour tool it aligns both coordinates; in the Metrics tool only the horizontal one. It moves nodes; it does not merge them. color flag color mark позначка approved User instruction 2026-10-04: use the compact flag sense in clear UI contexts; omit redundant color. In explanatory prose кольорова позначка remains valid. Bit flags and checkbox flags are separate senses. A color flag is a color you assign to a glyph cell, a kerning pair or a class to mark it for later. Flags are annotations for the designer and are not exported. corner angles кути у вершинах proposed No attestation; describes the definition (angles at contour vertices). The angles at contour vertices. These geometric measurements describe how adjacent segments meet at a corner and can be displayed on the canvas. cousins related glyphs alongside рідня proposed House voice: a plain collective noun for kin, like Polish kuzynostwo. No attestation. Rejected: родина (it is the font family), кузени (bookish), родичі. Cousins are related glyphs or other masters that FontLab shows faintly around the current glyph in the Glyph window, so you can compare shapes and spacing while you edit. The name is FontLab's, rendered in each language's house voice. crop обрізати proposed Inkscape (uk) (Обрізати зображення) and the corpus. Adobe and Apple use обтинання and кадрування, the photographic sense. Crop trims an image or drawing to a chosen area. The command label names the operation; its context identifies the object being cropped. cubic кубічний proposed FontForge (uk); inflect for the noun. A cubic Bézier segment is a curve defined by two endpoints and two control points. Cubic describes the degree of the curve, not its physical dimensions. current поточний proposed Standard in all Ukrainian software; inflect for the noun. Current identifies the item or state active at the time of an operation. Name the item, such as the current layer, when the context is ambiguous. cusp злам proposed No editor attestation; злам is the plain word for an abrupt break in a line and keeps cusp apart from гострий (sharp). Inkscape (uk) calls a cusp node гострий вузол. A cusp is a sharp point where a curve changes direction abruptly. Keep it distinct from a smooth join. decompose break into contours розкласти proposed No font-editor attestation: FontForge (uk) says відʼєднати for unlinking references. Розкласти (на контури) is plain Ukrainian. Rejected: розібрати, used here for expand. Decompose replaces components with copies of their contours, so the glyph no longer follows its source glyphs. Use it before edits that a component cannot carry, or before export to a format without composites. default типовий proposed FontForge (uk), Inkscape (uk), KDE and Apple (типово); inflect for the noun, adverb типово. Rejected: за замовчуванням, за промовчанням (Microsoft), a calque of the Russian phrase. A default is the value or choice used when no explicit alternative has been selected. It need not be the currently selected value. demo mode деморежим proposed Common Ukrainian software usage; the 2019 orthography writes демо- together. No font-specific attestation. Demo mode is how FontLab runs without a license: everything works except saving, exporting and printing. dialog діалогове вікно proposed Platform standard (Microsoft, Qt, Inkscape (uk)). Rejected: діалог (colloquial). A dialog presents information, settings or a question for a particular interaction. A modal dialog restricts interaction with its parent until it is dismissed; a modeless dialog does not. Use the application's established name and reproduce its button labels exactly. If a procedure opens a dialog, explain the relevant choices and how to apply or cancel them. Dream Up generate shapes Начаклувати proposed House voice, like Polish wyczaruj: conjure up. No attestation; Dream Up Font is Начаклувати шрифт. Dream Up is a Fontographer command for generating glyph shapes. Dream Up Font generates a whole font; Mixfont blends existing fonts. Keep these commands distinct and show any confirmed cost before the reader runs an operation. Generated shapes may need further editing. echo text repeated text відлуння тексту proposed No attestation; keeps the echo image with the native word. Повтор тексту is the plain alternative. Echo text makes a preview repeat the text of the current window, so the Preview panel or the TrueType hinting preview shows the same string you are editing. Eraser Гумка proposed Inkscape (uk): Інструмент «Гумка»; Adobe and Krita Ukrainian. Rejected: ластик (Russianism). The Eraser removes or simplifies points on a contour. In FontLab, its modes remove nodes and handles, select points for removal, or simplify a path. In Vexy Vextra, normal Eraser removes covered points; Soft Eraser removes a node only when a replacement curve is close enough to the original. That does not guarantee an identical outline. In Fontographer, Eraser shares a grouped toolbar button with Trowel. Name the application and mode when describing an operation. expand filter bake filter into contours розібрати фільтр proposed No Ukrainian attestation for this sense of Expand; розібрати says the live object is taken apart into plain contours. Adobe Ukrainian wording could not be verified. Expand filter bakes a live element filter, such as Smart Corners, Skin or a boolean Fusion, into plain contours. The filter parameters are no longer editable afterwards. expand stroke bake stroke into contours розібрати обведення proposed Derived from розібрати and обведення. Rejected: розширити штрих (FontForge (uk)), which says the stroke gets wider; Inkscape (uk) says штрих у контур. Expand stroke converts a stroked centerline, or a brush applied to a contour, into plain filled contours. The live stroke or brush is gone afterwards and the result can be edited node by node. expand transformation bake transformation into contours застосувати трансформацію proposed Розібрати does not fit a transformation; застосувати is what Ukrainian graphics software says for baking a transform. No font-editor attestation. Expand transformation writes an element's live transformation, such as scaling or rotation, into the node coordinates. The element then has an identity transformation and its contours carry the geometry directly. feature функція proposed Adobe Ukrainian help writes функції OpenType and Apple CoreText (uk) увімкнені функції. Rejected: модифікація (FontForge (uk)), можливість (InDesign), фіча (spoken jargon). A feature in OpenType editing identifies typographic behavior implemented by substitution or positioning lookups. Feature tags are literal identifiers and remain unchanged in translation. Fills Заливки proposed Adobe Ukrainian uses заливка for fill and Inkscape (uk) both заливка and заповнення. Rejected: заповнення, also any filling-in. In FontLab, the Fill tool sets enclosed regions as filled or unfilled by changing contour direction or applying a live Fill filter. In Vexy Lines, Linestra and Playlines, a fill mode is a method for generating artwork from an image, such as Halftone or Stipple. Name the application and distinguish the tool, the filled region and the generative mode. FontAudit ФонтАудит approved User requires phonetic transliteration, explicitly including Chinese. Russian and Ukrainian spellings were recovered from team QPH; other spellings are proposals. Retain the FontAudit identity; do not translate as a generic audit command. Preserve FontAudit in code and identifiers. FontAudit is the FontLab panel that inspects outlines and reports the problems a proof will show later: unclosed contours, wrong winding directions, missing extreme nodes, near vertical segments, and the like. You run it over a glyph or a selection, read the findings, and fix what matters for the design rather than clearing every warning. In English write the FontAudit panel on first mention. Localized UI may transliterate the name into its writing system; keep the name distinct from a generic audit command. Preserve FontAudit in code and identifiers. FontLab account обліковий запис FontLab proposed Translate the common noun account; preserve the FontLab brand. Contextual labels may omit the brand when already clear. A FontLab account is the identity used to sign in to FontLab services and manage licences. Keep the capital L in FontLab and lowercase account in English. Translate the common noun account while preserving the FontLab name. Distinguish the account from a licence, subscription or payment when more than one appears in the same explanation. Fusion Welder Зварник proposed User decision 2026-10-04: translate the fallback Welder, the named live boolean group filter. Polish Spawacz is explicit; other renderings are proposals. Preserve Fusion in code identifiers. Fusion is FontLab's live boolean filter on an element group: add, subtract, intersect or exclude the overlapping contours while the parts stay editable. Intersect keeps only the overlap; expand the filter to bake the result. Genius node self-balancing node вузол-геній proposed House voice, concept named rather than kept English; no attestation. Compact label: Геній. A Genius node keeps its curves smooth and balanced automatically when neighbours move; FontLab adjusts its handles for you. A Follower node follows key nodes under Power Nudge. Both are FontLab names, rendered in each language's house voice. grid сітка proposed Adobe, Apple, Microsoft and Inkscape (uk). Rejected: ґратка (FontForge (uk)). A grid is a set of regularly spaced reference lines or points used to position drawing objects. Keep it distinct from a mesh used for deformation. Groups Групи proposed Corpus best pick; the Projector Glyphs course writes кернінгові групи. A group collects several things and treats them as one, and the things differ by product. In FontLab the word most often means a kerning group, the set of glyphs that kern alike, which the documentation also calls a kerning class. In Vexy Vextra, following Illustrator, a group is selected artwork bound into one object. In Vexy Lines a group bundles layers and carries its own source image, working like a folder. TransType adds a styling group that ties a family's styles into a menu. Say which you mean. guide напрямна proposed FontForge (uk), Inkscape (uk), Adobe InDesign (uk) and the Projector Glyphs course. Rejected: направляюча (Russianism). A guide is a reference line used to position or align drawing objects. Its name describes its role rather than a visible stroke in the exported glyph. kerning mode режим кернінгу proposed Derived from кернінг; no attestation. The editing mode for adjusting spacing between pairs of glyphs. It changes pair adjustments rather than the individual glyph sidebearings. Knife Ніж proposed Corpus best pick; Inkscape and Adobe Ukrainian. The Knife tool works along a line you drag across a shape, and what it leaves behind differs by product and by sub-tool. In FontLab it adds nodes where the line crosses a contour, breaks a closed contour into open paths, or slices one contour into two closed shapes, depending on which of its three sub-tools is active. In Fontographer it cuts through contours along the drawn path. In Vexy Lines it inserts points and splits curves. Say which app, which mode, and what the cut leaves. layer шар proposed Universal in Ukrainian graphics software. Rejected: прошарок. A layer holds one drawing or part of a document. In FontLab, the context identifies the glyph layer; name the application when another product uses a different layer model. Layers Шари proposed Universal in Ukrainian graphics software. Layers hold the separate drawings a glyph or a document carries at once. In FontLab a glyph layer holds one master, a mask, or a background, and you manage them in the Layers and Masters panel, where switching layers switches which drawing you edit. In Vexy Lines a layer is a transparent sheet holding one or more fills, and it is the basic unit of a document, since artwork needs at least one. The two meanings sit close enough to be mistaken, so a sentence about layers names the application. mark діакритик proposed Apple CoreText (uk) uses діакритик as the countable noun (Варіант діакритика, Лігатури з діакритиками). Rejected: позначка (FontForge (uk)), kept here for a color flag. A mark in glyph positioning is a diacritical glyph positioned in relation to another glyph. A color mark or selection mark is a different interface meaning. Masks Маски proposed Corpus best pick; Adobe and the Projector Glyphs course use маска. A mask holds a second drawing, and what it does with that drawing differs by product. In FontLab a mask is a glyph layer carrying a previous version or a reference shape, so you can compare the live outline against it and copy between them; it hides nothing. In Vexy Lines a mask is a vector stencil that decides where a layer's fills can draw, letting the fill through its transparent areas and holding it back elsewhere. Name the application, and in FontLab prefer the full phrase mask layer. match узгодити proposed No fixed term; узгодити covers making properties or masters correspond. Rejected: відповідність, збіг (corpus, nouns for search matches). Match makes selected properties correspond. The object and context determine whether this means synchronizing edits, matching geometry or comparing values. matching відповідний proposed Plain adjective for things that correspond; inflect for the noun. Rejected: збігається (corpus pick, a filter phrase). Matching describes objects or properties that correspond. Name the matched property when the interface context does not identify it. Matchmaker master matcher Сват proposed House voice: the village matchmaker, like Polish Swatka. No attestation; сваха is the feminine alternative. Matchmaker is a FontLab tool for examining and correcting correspondence between glyph masters. It helps align contour order and start points for interpolation. Matching structures does not guarantee that intermediate outlines look right. Inspect the resulting interpolation; changing contour order or a start point can change correspondence without changing the outline's geometry at the master location. measurement line лінія вимірювання proposed Derived from вимірювання; no attestation. A line that shows a measured distance in the drawing. Distinguish this geometric measurement from a metrics line used to calculate sidebearings. measurements виміри proposed No attestation; the short plain word for measured values, apart from розміри (dimensions) and метрики. Values displayed on the canvas to describe geometry, such as coordinates, lengths, angles, tensions and counters. Showing measurements does not modify glyph spacing or font dimensions. Measurements panel панель «Виміри» proposed Derived from виміри; kept short because the panel labels are dense. The Measurements panel lists measured dimensions of the current font: stems, serifs, overshoots, contrast and heights, separately for capitals and lowercase. Its labels are compact; translations must not exceed the English length. merge обʼєднати proposed Adobe, Inkscape (uk) and the corpus. Rejected: злити, злиття. Merge combines items into a result. Name the items and explain what is retained when that distinction matters to the operation. mesh сіть proposed Сіть is attested three times in the corpus for a mesh and keeps it apart from сітка (grid), which Adobe and Inkscape (uk) use for both. A mesh is a network of connected points or cells used to describe or deform geometry.
